items.title: 美股亂流引發台股賣壓 法人仍看好中長期基本面支撐、留意個股分化趨勢
items.title_en: U.S. Market Turbulence Triggers Selling Pressure on Taiwan Stocks; Institutions Remain Bullish on Mid‑to‑Long‑Term Fundamentals and Watch for Stock‑Specific Divergence
paras: 受美股科技股震盪與財報雜音干擾，台股近期賣壓增溫，指數劇烈波動並反覆測試底部。法人指出，雖然短線市場情緒趨於保守，致使部分亮眼財報面臨獲利了結賣壓；但從中長期來看，美國雲端巨頭AI資本支出未減，台灣半導體與科技供應鏈的關鍵地位依舊穩固。在評價與高波動並存的環境下，拉回反倒提供了中長線分批布局與多元配置的良機。
針對近期盤勢，安聯台灣大壩基金暨安聯台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中表示，國際情勢、利率走勢、聯準會政策預期與AI投資疑慮等雜音持續干擾市場，導致短期投資情緒凌駕基本面，資金動能轉趨保守。即使部分企業繳出亮眼財報，仍面臨獲利了結賣壓，致使台股短線波動明顯放大。
蕭惠中指出，雖然短線市場將反覆測試底部，但台灣科技產業的基本面並未出現轉折。美國大型雲端服務業者持續擴大AI資本支出，雲端及先進運算需求維持強勁成長，且半導體與AI相關供應鏈訂單、營收動能無虞。隨著新一代伺服器逐步出貨，相關企業第四季營收可望延續成長力道，企業獲利仍是支撐台股中長期走勢的核心基石。
隨著市場進入高利率、高評價與高波動並存的環境，聯準會利率政策、美債殖利率及地緣政治對通膨的影響仍是後續主要變數。預期台股行情將由過去的全面齊漲，逐步轉向產業與個股分化，資金將更聚焦於營收及EPS成長能見度高的企業。
在產業配置方面，安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆指出，目前投資組合以金融控股為最大產業配置，藉此提升持股多元性，並掌握市場資金輪動機會；成長布局則廣泛涵蓋半導體晶圓代工、先進封裝、記憶體、IC設計、半導體設備、PCB、工業電腦及散熱等科技供應鏈，持續掌握AI與高效能運算需求成長所帶動的結構性投資機會。
paras_en: The recent sell‑off in Taiwan equities has intensified as U.S. tech stocks wobble and earnings noise creates interference, causing the index to swing wildly and repeatedly test its lows. Institutions note that while short‑term market sentiment has become cautious—leading to profit‑taking pressure on some standout earnings—the mid‑to‑long‑term outlook remains solid: U.S. cloud giants continue robust AI capital spending and Taiwan’s semiconductor and tech supply chain retains its pivotal role. In a setting of high valuations and volatility, the pullback actually offers a good chance for phased, diversified positioning over the medium to long term.

Regarding the latest market action, Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund and Allianz Taiwan Tech Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung said that international developments, interest‑rate trends, Fed policy expectations and AI‑investment concerns continue to cloud the market, causing short‑term sentiment to outweigh fundamentals and capital flows to become more conservative. Even companies delivering impressive earnings face profit‑taking pressure, amplifying short‑term volatility in Taiwan stocks.

Hsu pointed out that although the short‑term market will keep testing the bottom, the fundamentals of Taiwan’s tech industry have not turned. Major U.S. cloud service providers are still expanding AI capital expenditures, keeping demand for cloud and high‑performance computing strong, and semiconductor and AI‑related supply‑chain orders and revenue momentum remain intact. As the next‑generation servers roll out, related firms are expected to sustain revenue growth into Q4, with corporate earnings remaining the core support for Taiwan’s mid‑to‑long‑term market trajectory.

As the market moves into an environment of high rates, high valuations and high volatility, the Fed’s rate policy, U.S. Treasury yields and geopolitical impacts on inflation remain the key variables ahead. The Taiwan market is expected to shift from a broad‑based rally to increasing sector and stock‑specific divergence, with capital focusing more on companies that show clear revenue and EPS growth visibility.

On the sector‑allocation side, Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW) manager Liao Pen‑Long said the current portfolio is weighted most heavily toward financial holding companies to boost diversification and capture fund‑rotation opportunities. The growth tilt spans semiconductor wafer foundries, advanced packaging, memory, IC design, semiconductor equipment, PCBs, industrial PCs and cooling solutions, continuously targeting structural investment opportunities driven by AI and high‑performance computing demand growth.

items.title: 金居啟動大馬建廠計畫 高階銅箔新廠落腳居林、取得3.12萬坪土地
items.title_en: Jinju Launches Malaysia Plant Project, New High-End Copper Foil Factory to Be Built in Kulim, Acquires 31,200 Ping Land
paras: 2026年挑戰賺回一個股本的銅箔廠金居(8358-TW)，積極擴充高頻、高速銅箔產能以因應市場AI產品的高速需求擴張，金居除雲林三廠2027年逐季開出新產能之外，亦規劃於馬來西亞檳城周邊設立新廠，宣布取得馬國吉打州的居林高科技園區Kulim Hi-Tech Park Phase 4A的土地使用權資產，總面積換算達3.12萬坪。
大馬的吉打州的居林高科技園區(Kulim Hi-Tech Park)區域內科技業者，包括了生產高階載板的AT&S公司及英特爾、英飛凌、富士電機。金居規劃投資馬國新廠占地達3.12萬坪，主要生產HVLP4高頻高速高階應用銅箔，整體規劃產能達年產3萬噸。
金居規劃於馬來西亞居林高科技園區設立新廠，預計分兩期建置，第一批產能將於2028年第三至第四季陸續開出，第二期則規劃於2029年下半年啟動，並以分階段擴充。金居馬來西亞新廠總投資金額初估約80億至100億元，同時，金居也擬在台灣發行可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資支應，預估其發行面額在70億元水準。
金居並規劃於馬來西亞Kulim Hi-Tech Park設立新廠，設定除可供應在馬國設廠的CCL廠台光電(2383-TW)之外，在中南半島的泰國設廠的台燿(6274-TW)、騰輝-KY(6672-TW)及聯茂(6213-TW)也將爲設定客戶對象。
金居對在馬來西亞居林高科技園區投資興建新廠，將以HVLP4為主要生產方向規劃，搭配台灣三廠的高階銅箔產能，形成未來高階產品供應布局。而台灣三廠產能也將逐季開出；隨著AI伺服器及高速傳輸技術持續升級，對低損耗、高性能銅箔的要求同步提高，公司將透過新廠建置及既有產線產品調整，擴大高階銅箔供應能力，支應未來市場需求。
paras_en: In 2026, Jinju (8358-TW), a copper foil plant aiming to earn back one share capital, is actively expanding high‑frequency, high‑speed copper foil capacity to meet the rapid growth of AI product demand. Besides rolling out new capacity at its three Yunlin factories quarter by quarter in 2027, Jinju also plans to set up a new plant near Penang, Malaysia, announcing that it has secured land‑use rights in Phase 4A of the Kulim Hi‑Tech Park in Kedah, Malaysia, amounting to a total of about 31,200 ping.

Kedah’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park hosts technology companies such as AT&S, which produces high‑end substrates, as well as Intel, Infineon and Fuji Electric. Jinju plans to invest in a new Malaysian plant covering 31,200 ping, primarily to produce HVLP4 high‑frequency, high‑speed, high‑end application copper foil, with an overall design capacity of 30,000 tonnes per year.

Jinju intends to build the new plant in Kulim Hi‑Tech Park in two phases. The first batch of capacity is expected to come online gradually in the third to fourth quarters of 2028, while the second phase is slated to start in the second half of 2029 with staged expansions. The total investment for the Malaysian plant is initially estimated at NT$8‑10 billion, and Jinju also plans to issue convertible bonds (CB) in Taiwan to raise funds, with an anticipated issuance amount of around NT$7 billion.

Jinju’s plan for the new plant in Malaysia’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park includes serving not only CCL’s Taiwan Semiconductor (2383‑TW), which has a plant in Malaysia, but also other regional customers such as Taiwan’s Tai Yao (6274‑TW) in Thailand, Teng‑Hui‑KY (6672‑TW) and Lian‑Mao (6213‑TW).

Jinju’s investment in a new plant at Kulim Hi‑Tech Park will focus on HVLP4 production, complementing the high‑end copper foil capacity of its three Taiwanese factories to create a future supply network for premium products. As the three Taiwanese plants ramp up capacity quarter by quarter, the ongoing upgrades in AI servers and high‑speed transmission technologies are driving higher demand for low‑loss, high‑performance copper foil. The company will expand its high‑end copper foil supply capability through the new plant and adjustments to existing lines to meet future market needs.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：美國期中選舉、蘋果財報、非農就業報告
items.title_en: This Week's Trading Notes: U.S. Midterm Elections, Apple Earnings, Nonfarm Payroll Report
paras: 美股本周將迎來美國期中選舉、密集企業財報及10月就業報告三大考驗。人工智慧(AI)投資的資金需求與獲利前景疑慮持續升溫，蘋果(AAPL-US)、超微(AMD-US)與Palantir(PLTR-US)等指標企業能否交出亮眼成績，以及選後監管方向，都將牽動市場信心。
Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)財報令人失望，英特爾(INTC-US)上周五財報後更重挫近29%，拖累標普500指數下跌1.8%，那斯達克綜合指數下挫2.9%。投資人日益關切，支撐美股多頭行情的AI題材，能否取得足夠融資並創造相應回報。

期中選舉登場 AI監管前景受矚目

周二(3日)登場的期中選舉，將決定民主黨能否從川普所屬的共和黨手中奪回國會控制權。目前外界普遍預期民主黨有望拿下眾議院，參議院選情則較不明朗；共和黨在川普本屆任期前兩年掌控參眾兩院。
資料中心對能源成本與環境的影響，已引發強烈民意反彈。雖然市場對於任何一黨勝選後，是否真能推動足以重創AI投資的法案仍有疑慮，但若民主黨同時拿下兩院，相關產業預料將面臨更嚴格檢視。德州等地的州級與地方選舉，也可能影響資料中心擴建。
Cherry Lane Investments合夥人Rick Meckler認為，若民主黨掀起顯著「藍色浪潮」，市場可能將其視為AI概念股、科技股乃至整體股市的利空。國防與醫療保健類股同樣對選情敏感，財政支出方向的變化可能牽動資產價格，銀行與加密貨幣業也可能面臨更大監管壓力。

蘋果、超微接棒財報 高成長仍須跨越高門檻

企業獲利強勁，是今年美股上漲的重要支柱。根據倫敦證交所集團旗下IBES截至上周五的資料，已有逾半數標普500企業公布第三季財報，整體獲利預估年增31.6%，但亮眼成長也墊高市場期待。
開拓重工(CAT-US)便是一例。儘管資料中心帶動發電設備需求強勁，公司仍維持全年營收成長預測，股價上周四大跌9%。富蘭克林坦伯頓研究院首席市場策略師Chris Galipeau表示，財報門檻非常高，企業若無法超越，就可能遭市場懲罰。
蘋果將於周一公布財報，股價今年來已上漲約27%。超微、高通(QCOM-US)與Palantir也將接棒，讓投資人進一步檢視晶片需求與AI商業化進展。麥當勞(MCD-US)、安進(AMGN-US)及康菲石油(COP-US)亦在名單之列，本周共有逾100家標普500企業公布業績。

就業報告壓軸 非科技類股撐起行情

周五(6日)公布的10月就業報告，將提供判斷美國經濟健康程度的重要線索。最新數據顯示，受惠於消費支出穩健、企業加碼AI投資，美國第三季經濟成長速度創一年來最快。
聯準會(Fed)上周維持利率不變，並上調對經濟的評估。不過，Manulife John Hancock Investments共同首席投資策略師Matthew Miskin指出，強勁經濟成長敘事中，目前缺少的仍是就業成長。
在AI與相關科技股受挫之際，其他類股已接力支撐大盤。能源、金融，以及公用事業、醫療保健等防禦型類股，10月均錄得可觀漲幅，標普500指數今年來仍上漲逾10%。本周選舉、財報與就業數據接連出爐，將進一步考驗這波漲勢能否延續。
paras_en: U.S. equities this week will confront three major tests: the U.S. midterm elections, a slate of corporate earnings, and the October jobs report. Concerns are rising over the funding needs and profit outlook for AI investments, and market confidence will hinge on whether flagship names such as Apple (AAPL-US), AMD (AMD-US) and Palantir (PLTR-US) can deliver strong results, as well as on post‑election regulatory direction.

Alphabet (GOOGL-US, GOOG-US), the parent of Google, and Amazon (AMZN-US) posted disappointing earnings, and Intel (INTC-US) slumped nearly 29% after its Friday report, pulling the S&P 500 down 1.8% and the Nasdaq Composite down 2.9%. Investors are increasingly worried whether AI‑driven bullishness in U.S. stocks can secure enough financing and generate the expected returns.
This week’s trading notes (Nov 2‑Nov 6)

Midterm elections bring AI‑regulation outlook into focus. The elections on Tuesday (the 3rd) will decide whether Democrats can wrest control of Congress from the Trump‑aligned Republicans. The consensus view is that Democrats are likely to win the House, while the Senate remains uncertain; Republicans currently control both chambers for the first two years of Trump’s term.

Data‑center energy costs and environmental impact have sparked strong public backlash. Although the market doubts whether any party that wins can actually pass legislation that would severely curb AI investment, a Democratic sweep of both chambers would likely subject related industries to tighter scrutiny. State and local races in places like Texas could also affect data‑center expansion plans.

Rick Meckler, a partner at Cherry Lane Investments, believes that a pronounced “blue wave” could be seen as a negative for AI‑themed stocks, technology shares and the broader market. Defense and healthcare stocks are also election‑sensitive, and shifts in fiscal‑spending priorities could move asset prices, while banks and the cryptocurrency sector may face heightened regulatory pressure.

Apple and AMD are set to follow the earnings trail, but high growth still must clear lofty hurdles. Strong corporate profits have been a key driver of this year’s U.S. equity rally. According to IBES data from the London Stock Exchange Group as of last Friday, more than half of the S&P 500 constituents have reported Q3 results, with overall earnings expected to rise 31.6% year‑over‑year, raising market expectations even further.

Caterpillar (CAT-US) is a case in point. Even though data‑center demand is boosting orders for power equipment, the company kept its full‑year revenue growth forecast, yet its stock plunged 9% last Thursday. Chris Galipeau, chief market strategist at Franklin Templeton, warned that earnings thresholds are extremely high; companies that fail to exceed them may be punished by the market.

Apple will release its earnings on Monday, having already risen about 27% this year. AMD, Qualcomm (QCOM-US) and Palantir will follow, giving investors a chance to gauge chip demand and AI commercialization progress. McDonald’s (MCD-US), Amgen (AMGN-US) and ConocoPhillips (COP-US) are also on the list, with more than 100 S&P 500 companies slated to report earnings this week.

The October jobs report, due Friday (the 6th), will provide a key gauge of U.S. economic health. The latest data show that, buoyed by solid consumer spending and increased corporate AI investment, U.S. Q3 economic growth was the fastest in a year.

The Fed kept rates unchanged last week and upgraded its economic outlook. However, Matthew Miskin, co‑chief investment strategist at Manulife John Hancock Investments, noted that the strong growth narrative still lacks one crucial element: job growth.

While AI‑related stocks have stumbled, other sectors have stepped in to support the market. Energy, financials, utilities and healthcare – traditionally defensive categories – all posted solid gains in October, keeping the S&P 500 up more than 10% year‑to‑date. This week’s elections, earnings and jobs data will further test whether the rally can continue.

items.title: Meta攜手中國傅里葉開發人形機器人「Max」！第二代啟動研發、搭載輝達晶片
items.title_en: Meta Teams Up with China’s Fourier to Develop Humanoid Robot “Max”! Second Generation Development Launched, Powered by Nvidia Chip
paras: Meta(META-US) 正將人工智慧（AI）布局從數位服務延伸至實體世界。知情人士指出，Meta已與中國機器人公司傅里葉（Fourier）合作開發人形機器人原型，內部代號為「Max」，並於今年9月啟動第二代產品的研發，顯示Meta正加快推進消費級人形機器人布局。
根據《The Information》週日（1日）報導，知情人士指出，Meta首席技術長Andrew Bosworth將人形機器人定位為旗下消費級AI代理Muse的「實體化身」，希望讓AI不再侷限於數位環境，而是能在家庭場景中實際執行任務。
該計畫最終目標是推出面向消費者的成熟產品，但目前尚未訂定上市時程。

Max三個月完成原型 搭載輝達晶片

根據報導，Meta與傅里葉僅花約三個月便完成第一代Max原型機。這款機器人身高約1.5公尺、重量約48公斤，採用輝達(NVDA-US) Jetson Thor晶片作為運算核心，並搭配獨立的運動控制軟體平台。
Max胸部內建雙揚聲器，臉部能模擬人類表情，五指機械手則可抓取小瓶子、玩具等物品。
其硬體基礎來自傅里葉前三代機器人產品，雙方進一步重新設計身體比例、頭部、顯示螢幕及攝影機，並新增手部與腳部模組。
為了讓機器人適應家庭環境，Meta也設定具體的感知能力要求，包括辨識5公尺外的人聲、理解3公尺外的手勢或揮手動作，以及維持眼神接觸。
此外，機器人還必須透過狀態訊號，讓使用者辨別其正處於聆聽、思考、說話或不確定等不同狀態。
據報導，Meta機器人產品副總裁Li-Chen Miller曾在傅里葉上海工廠駐點近兩個月，與當地團隊共同推進原型開發。Max並於今年8月底在Meta內部機器人峰會上首次進行實體展示。

Max 2啟動開發 強化操控與爬樓梯能力

Meta與傅里葉已於今年9月展開第二代原型機Max 2的研發，新版本將重新設計軀幹結構，並改善手部機械設計，以提升操作精度。
此外，Max 2預計新增投影機，讓機器人能呈現視覺內容，並加入額外感測器，使其具備上下樓梯的能力。
Meta也開始為後續可能的量產作業建立人才與供應鏈布局。根據《The Information》取得的招聘資訊，Meta正在上海招募供應商開發工程師，負責協助產品從原型階段邁向量產；深圳的Meta Robotics Studio則招募產品設計工程師及技術專案經理，工作範圍涵蓋原型開發、產品規劃與量產管理。
不過，Meta發言人表示，由於部分相關零組件在美國仍不容易取得，公司面臨與整個產業相同的供應挑戰。Meta目前與傅里葉的合作僅限內部研究及實驗，現階段沒有銷售這些機器人的計畫。

中國廠商搶先布局 Meta面臨激烈競爭

若Meta未來正式進軍消費級人形機器人市場，將面臨來自中國廠商及美國科技業者的競爭。
中國企業已在人形機器人的規模化生產方面取得領先，特斯拉(TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克也持續加碼Optimus人形機器人計畫，第三代產品已投入生產。此外，Figure與1X Technologies等新創公司也已投入相關技術開發多年。
不過，人形機器人真正進入家庭並執行日常工作的應用仍處於早期階段。Figure已開始在家庭環境測試旗下機器人，1X Technologies則已開放NEO機器人預訂。
另一方面，美國政府近期也加強對中國機器人產業的審查。美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）宣布對外國製造的先進機器人實施進口限制，涵蓋中國企業占有重要地位的人形機器人市場。
中國外交部發言人毛寧7月29日對此表示，反對美方泛化國家安全概念打壓中國企業，並稱保護主義無法提升美國競爭力，反而會損害企業與消費者利益。
機器人部門人事異動 Bosworth親自接手
Meta機器人部門近期也出現管理層變動。兩名知情人士透露，曾任通用汽車（GM）旗下自動駕駛公司Cruise執行長的Marc Whitten，在加入Meta約18個月後，已於今年8月底離職。
Meta隨後任命Ning Li擔任Meta Robotics Studio臨時負責人，直接向Bosworth匯報。
知情人士表示，Bosworth接手Whitten原本負責的工作後，已更深入參與機器人業務，不僅定期與團隊開會，也親自了解部門在技術開發及營運方面面臨的具體挑戰。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is extending its artificial intelligence (AI) footprint from digital services into the physical world. Sources say Meta has partnered with Chinese robotics firm Fourier to develop a humanoid robot prototype, internally codenamed “Max,” and kicked off development of a second‑generation product in September, indicating Meta is accelerating its consumer‑grade humanoid robot push.

According to a Sunday (the 1st) report by The Information, sources said Meta chief technology officer Andrew Bosworth envisions the humanoid robot as the “physical embodiment” of the company’s consumer‑grade AI assistant Muse, aiming to take AI out of purely digital environments and let it perform tasks in home settings.
The ultimate goal of the project is to launch a mature consumer product, but no launch timeline has been set yet.

Max prototype built in three months, equipped with Nvidia chip
The report says Meta and Fourier spent roughly three months to complete the first‑generation Max prototype. The robot stands about 1.5 metres tall, weighs around 48 kg, and uses Nvidia (NVDA-US) Jetson Thor chips as its computing core, paired with a dedicated motion‑control software platform.
Max’s chest houses dual speakers, its face can mimic human expressions, and its five‑finger mechanical hand can grasp small bottles, toys and similar objects.

Its hardware foundation comes from Fourier’s first three robot generations; both parties further redesigned the body proportions, head, display screen and cameras, and added new hand and foot modules.

To make the robot suitable for home environments, Meta set concrete perception requirements, including recognizing human voices from five metres away, understanding gestures or waving motions from three metres away, and maintaining eye contact.
In addition, the robot must convey its status via signals so users can tell whether it is listening, thinking, speaking or uncertain.

According to the report, Meta robot product vice‑president Li‑Chen Miller spent nearly two months stationed at Fourier’s Shanghai factory, working with the local team to advance prototype development. Max was first shown in physical form at Meta’s internal robot summit at the end of August.

Max 2 development launched, enhancing manipulation and stair‑climbing abilities
Meta and Fourier began development of the second‑generation prototype Max 2 in September. The new version will redesign the torso structure and improve the hand mechanism to boost operational precision.
Furthermore, Max 2 is expected to add a projector so the robot can display visual content, and include extra sensors to give it the ability to go up and down stairs.

Meta has also started building talent and supply‑chain capabilities for potential mass production. Recruiting information obtained by The Information shows Meta is hiring supplier development engineers in Shanghai to help move the product from prototype to production; Meta Robotics Studio in Shenzhen is hiring product design engineers and technical project managers covering prototype development, product planning and production management.

However, a Meta spokesperson said that some related components remain hard to obtain in the United States, and the company faces the same supply challenges as the broader industry. Meta’s collaboration with Fourier is limited to internal research and experimentation, and there are currently no plans to sell these robots.

Chinese firms move ahead, Meta faces fierce competition
If Meta eventually enters the consumer‑grade humanoid robot market, it will face competition from Chinese manufacturers as well as U.S. tech companies.

Chinese companies have taken the lead in scaling up humanoid robot production; Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk continues to invest in the Optimus humanoid robot program, with the third generation already in production. Start‑ups such as Figure and 1X Technologies have also been developing related technologies for years.

Nevertheless, real‑world household deployment of humanoid robots for everyday tasks is still in its early stages. Figure has begun testing its robot in home environments, and 1X Technologies has opened pre‑orders for its NEO robot.

Meanwhile, the U.S. government has recently tightened scrutiny of China’s robotics industry. The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) announced import restrictions on advanced robots manufactured abroad, covering the humanoid robot market where Chinese firms hold a significant share.

Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said on July 29 that she opposes the U.S. broad‑brush national‑security rationale that suppresses Chinese firms, arguing that protectionism does not boost U.S. competitiveness but harms businesses and consumers.
Robotics division personnel changes, Bosworth takes over personally

Meta’s robotics division has recently seen leadership changes. Two sources said Marc Whitten, who previously served as CEO of Cruise, General Motors’ autonomous‑driving unit, left Meta at the end of August after about 18 months with the company.
Meta subsequently appointed Ning Li as interim head of Meta Robotics Studio, reporting directly to Bosworth.

Sources said Bosworth, after taking over Whitten’s responsibilities, has become more deeply involved in the robotics business, not only holding regular meetings with the team but also personally understanding the specific technical development and operational challenges the division faces.

items.title: 輝達展示下一代光互連技術OOI！光引擎整合矽中介層、量產最快2030年後
items.title_en: NVIDIA Showcases Next-Gen Optical Interconnect Technology OOI! Optical Engine Integrated onto Silicon Interposer, Mass Production Not Expected Until After 2030
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正持續推進人工智慧（AI）晶片的光互連技術，並在近期於美國舊金山舉行的半導體展覽會SEMICON West 2026上，展示下一代共同封裝光學（CPO）技術原型，命名為OOI（Optics-on-Interposer，中介層上集成光學）。這項技術進一步將光引擎整合至運算晶片使用的矽中介層，有望縮短訊號傳輸路徑、降低功耗，但封裝與散熱仍是未來量產必須克服的難題。
一位光通訊晶片公司相關人士指出，OOI與現行CPO最大的差異，在於光引擎（OE）不再配置獨立的有機基板，而是直接與運算晶片共用矽中介層。
現行量產CPO技術已將光引擎從傳統可插拔光模組移至交換晶片旁的有機基板，OOI則進一步將光引擎整合至運算晶片所在的中介層。
透過短距離、細間距布線，OOI可讓電訊號不必繞經有機基板，進一步縮短傳輸路徑，提升訊號傳輸效率並降低功耗，同時增加頻寬密度。
這項設計概念與目前GPU透過矽中介層高速連接高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的方式相近，目標是突破AI晶片對外傳輸的頻寬瓶頸。
不過，光引擎與高功耗運算晶片整合在同一中介層，也帶來新的工程挑戰。光通訊晶片業者指出，光學元件對溫度相當敏感，卻必須與功耗達數百瓦的運算晶片共同封裝，使散熱管理、光學耦合精度及後續維修都變得更加困難，其中散熱尤其棘手。
此外，OOI也將光學元件的封裝難度與技術價值推向更高層次。由於矽中介層產能、產品規格及封裝良率主要掌握在先進封裝廠手中，隨著光引擎與運算晶片的距離縮短、電訊號通道減少，封裝在整體方案中的價值也將提高，進一步強化先進封裝業者在AI晶片供應鏈中的地位。
輝達研究院首席研究科學家Nikola Nedovic表示，公司已取得OOI原型樣品，正針對未來產品進行評估，但商業化仍有技術問題尚待解決。

OOI尚無量產時程　2030年後才可能導入

目前輝達並未公布OOI的商業化或量產時間表。業界人士認為，中短期內這項技術不會對中國光通訊產業造成明顯影響，輝達預計2028年推出的Feynman架構仍將採用CPO方案，OOI真正進入量產階段可能要等到2030年以後。
相較之下，輝達第一代CPO技術已開始進入規模化量產階段。輝達8月14日透過官方社群帳號宣布，全球首款每通道200G的共同封裝光學（CPO）乙太網路交換器系統已全面量產。
供應鏈方面，該系統由Lumentum(LITE-US) 提供雷射晶片、天孚通信(300394-CN) 負責雷射器模組子組件組裝、台積電(2330-TW) 提供矽光子製程、矽品負責封裝，最後由鴻海(2317-TW) 完成系統整合。首批客戶包括CoreWeave、Lambda及甲骨文。
輝達10月21日在GTC柏林大會上進一步宣布，將與矽品等合作夥伴擴大CPO光引擎產能，目標在2027年年中提升至目前的15倍，並在2028年底前再擴大一倍。若兩階段目標均順利達成，產能將較目前增加約30倍。

光互連技術路線並存　供應鏈價值重新分配

從產業發展來看，光互連技術正逐步從傳統可插拔光模組，朝向線性可插拔光學（LPO）、近封裝光學（NPO）及CPO等方向演進，未來再進一步發展至OOI。不過，目前各種技術方案仍處於並行發展階段，尚未全面由單一技術取代。
中國業者目前在NPO領域進展較快，海外業者則以輝達為代表，積極推進CPO技術。劍橋科技副總經理暨首席技術官趙海波指出，機櫃內的Scale-up互連目前仍以銅纜為主，但在跨機櫃應用中，光傳輸正逐步取代銅纜，傳統可插拔光模組明年仍將是市場主力。
他也表示，在單波100G方案中，並不需要導入NPO或CPO，光模組的產品形態仍將隨技術演進而調整。
隨著光互連架構持續升級，產業鏈的價值分配也正在改變。傳統可插拔光模組時代，價值主要集中在光模組與光晶片；進入CPO時代後，產業價值則逐漸轉向矽光子晶片、先進封裝、外置光源、無源元件，以及散熱與測試等環節。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is continuing to advance optical interconnect technology for its artificial‑intelligence (AI) chips and recently displayed a prototype of its next‑generation co‑packaged optics (CPO) technology at the SEMICON West 2026 semiconductor exhibition in San Francisco, naming it OOI (Optics‑on‑Interposer). The technology further integrates the optical engine into the silicon interposer used by compute chips, promising shorter signal paths and lower power consumption, though packaging and thermal management remain hurdles for volume production.

A source from an optical‑communication chip company noted that the biggest difference between OOI and current CPO is that the optical engine (OE) no longer uses a separate organic substrate but shares the silicon interposer directly with the compute chip.

Current mass‑produced CPO technology has moved the optical engine from a traditional pluggable optical module onto an organic substrate placed next to the switch chip; OOI pushes the integration further by embedding the optical engine into the same interposer that hosts the compute chip.

By using short‑distance, fine‑pitch routing, OOI eliminates the need for electrical signals to travel via the organic substrate, further shortening the transmission path, improving signal efficiency and reducing power draw while increasing bandwidth density.

The design concept is similar to how GPUs currently use silicon interposers to achieve high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) connections, aiming to break the bandwidth bottleneck for AI chips’ external data transfer.

However, integrating a high‑power compute chip and an optical engine on the same interposer introduces new engineering challenges. Optical components are highly temperature‑sensitive, yet they must be co‑packaged with compute chips that dissipate hundreds of watts, making thermal management, optical coupling precision and later maintenance considerably more difficult, with heat removal being especially problematic.

Moreover, OOI raises the packaging difficulty and technical value of the optical components. Since silicon‑interposer capacity, product specifications and yield are largely controlled by advanced‑packaging foundries, shortening the distance between the optical engine and compute chip and reducing electrical channels increase the overall solution’s value, further strengthening advanced‑packaging players’ position in the AI‑chip supply chain.

Nikolа Nedović, chief research scientist at NVIDIA Research, said the company has obtained OOI prototype samples and is evaluating them for future products, but commercialization still faces unresolved technical issues.

OOI has no announced mass‑production timeline and is unlikely to be introduced before 2030. NVIDIA has not disclosed a commercialization schedule. Industry observers believe the technology will not have a noticeable impact on China’s optical‑communication sector in the near‑ to mid‑term, and NVIDIA’s Feynman architecture slated for 2028 will still use the CPO approach; OOI may not reach volume production until after 2030.

In contrast, NVIDIA’s first‑generation CPO technology has already entered scaled‑up production. On August 14, NVIDIA announced via its official channels that the world’s first 200 Gbps‑per‑channel co‑packaged optics Ethernet switch system is now in full production.

The supply chain for that system includes Lumentum (LITE‑US) supplying laser chips, Tianfu Communication (300394‑CN) assembling laser‑module sub‑components, TSMC (2330‑TW) providing silicon‑photonics processes, Siliconware (Silicon‑IP) handling packaging, and Foxconn (2317‑TW) completing system integration. Initial customers are CoreWeave, Lambda and Oracle.

At the GTC Berlin conference on October 21, NVIDIA further announced that, together with Siliconware and other partners, it will expand CPO optical‑engine capacity to 15 times the current level by mid‑2027 and double that again by the end of 2028, which would raise total capacity roughly 30‑fold if both milestones are met.

Optical‑interconnect technology routes coexist, reshaping supply‑chain value. The industry is moving from traditional pluggable optical modules toward linear pluggable optics (LPO), near‑package optics (NPO) and CPO, with OOI representing the next step. All these approaches are currently developing in parallel and no single solution has yet dominated.

Chinese players are advancing faster in the NPO space, while overseas firms, led by NVIDIA, are actively pushing CPO. Zhao Haibo, deputy GM and CTO of Cambridge Technology, said that within rack cabinets, scale‑up interconnects still rely mainly on copper cables, but for cross‑rack applications optical transmission is gradually replacing copper, and traditional pluggable optical modules will remain the market mainstay next year.
He also noted that for single‑wave 100 Gbps solutions, there is no need to adopt NPO or CPO yet; the form factor of optical modules will continue to evolve with technology.

As optical‑interconnect architectures keep upgrading, the value distribution across the industry chain is shifting. In the era of traditional pluggable modules, value was concentrated in the modules and optical chips; in the CPO era, value is moving toward silicon‑photonics chips, advanced packaging, external light sources, passive components, as well as thermal and test services.

items.title: 高盛示警AI資本支出成長恐見頂！科技巨頭變現能力受考驗、年底股市關鍵看油價
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Warns AI Capital Expenditure Growth May Reach Peak! Tech Giants' Monetization Capabilities Tested, Year-End Stock Market Keyly Dependent on Oil Prices
paras: 高盛分析師指出，全球人工智慧（AI）基礎設施投資正進入新的階段，市場對科技巨頭資本支出的樂觀預期開始面臨考驗。隨著雲端業者財報表現出現分歧，AI投資能否順利轉化為營收與獲利，已成為市場關注焦點。
另一方面，美國聯準會（Fed）政策路徑與市場利率定價仍存在落差，高盛認為，市場可能高估後續升息幅度，全球短期利率年底前有望走低。至於股債市場能否擺脫近期震盪，則取決於中東局勢是否進一步升級，以及能源價格能否回落。
在高盛最新一期市場討論節目《Brace the Game》中，主持人與高盛全球風險主管 Josh Schiffrin、研究部資深顧問 Dominic Wilson 針對聯準會政策、AI投資趨勢、能源風險及年底市場布局交換看法。

聯準會升息幅度可能低於市場預期

談到聯準會最新決策，Schiffrin認為，本次會議結果大致符合預期，也反映官員會前釋出的政策訊號。儘管通膨壓力依然嚴峻，聯準會仍有空間觀察更多經濟數據，再決定後續政策方向。
他指出，聯準會主席提到，9月採取的政策措施已開始發揮效果，金融環境雖尚未達到全面緊縮的程度，但確實已有所收緊。這使他對聯準會後續政策立場維持相對鴿派的看法。
目前市場已反映未來可能再升息60至65個基點，但Josh認為，聯準會實際升息幅度可能低於市場定價，基準預期是12月再升息一次，之後便可能結束本輪升息。
Wilson則指出，近期利率回落有幾項原因。首先，部分主權債市場與高收益信用債開始出現壓力，顯示先前的利率水準已對金融體系不同領域造成負擔。
其次，利率此前已升至較難維持的水準。從隔夜指數交換（OIS）遠期定價來看，10年期遠期利率一度觸及約5.2%，已相當接近過去20年政策利率週期的高點，代表市場已納入相當高的風險溢價。
此外，AI概念股近期走勢轉弱，也使市場重新評估經濟成長前景。Wilson認為，這波市場變化顯示，成長動能與經濟放緩疑慮，對公債殖利率的影響可能比原先預期更大。

AI資本支出增速恐見頂 變現能力成關鍵

談到AI投資趨勢，Wilson認為，市場對這項主題的看法正變得更加複雜。過去幾年，AI一直是市場最受追捧的投資主題，但隨著部分領域估值過高，投資人需要對未來成長抱持相當樂觀的預期，才能合理化相關企業與基礎設施類股的股價。
如今，市場收到的訊號已不再一面倒偏多。從最新財報來看，科技巨頭的表現開始出現分歧，而高盛也預期，AI投資熱潮的增速高峰可能已經不遠。
Wilson強調，這不代表AI投資即將停止，未來仍會有大量資金投入相關領域，但資本支出成長速度可能很快就會見頂。
此外，AI基礎設施投資所需的融資規模龐大，信貸市場已開始浮現一些疲弱跡象，超大型雲端服務業者（Hyperscalers）如何將鉅額投資轉化為實際營收與獲利，也仍存在疑問。
他認為，當AI產業的成長故事開始出現變化，同時利率上升、信用利差擴大，市場便會從過去追逐成長的模式，轉向更傳統的企業基本面評估。AI投資的風險與報酬也因此變得更加對稱，不再是過去三年那種幾乎一面倒受到追捧的超級投資主題。
主持人則指出，過去約半年來，市場持續受到利率、能源價格及信貸環境等宏觀因素牽制，但企業獲利仍展現韌性。
以本季財報來看，整體表現雖然尚可，但市場原本的預期門檻就相當高，遠期獲利預估也沒有像第一、第二季財報季時大幅上修。若排除私募股權產業，企業獲利成長率可能達到20%後段，甚至超過30%。
不過，財報表現目前主要是守住市場原有預期，尚不足以成為推動股市再度大幅上漲的催化劑。

中東局勢與油價成年底市場最大變數

展望年底前的市場風險，Schiffrin認為，中東局勢升級是目前最值得關注的威脅。如果衝突擴大，帶動能源價格再度上漲，將成為金融市場最大的短期風險。
反之，若局勢緩和、油價下跌，將有助於改善通膨前景，減輕各國央行的升息壓力，並為股票與債券市場帶來利多。
在年底前的投資布局上，Schiffrin最看好全球短期利率走低。他認為，市場目前反映的升息幅度超過央行實際可能採取的行動，美國、歐洲及英國的利率定價都存在類似情況。
此外，若市場對信貸風險的擔憂升高，或投資人重新調整對央行政策路徑的預期，也可能進一步推動短期利率下行。
Wilson則認為，市場已經為中東局勢可能升級納入相當程度的風險溢價，尤其原油市場已反映實質的地緣政治風險。
他指出，儘管11月仍存在局勢升級的可能，但如果衝突沒有進一步惡化，或實際情況未達市場最悲觀的預期，能源價格中的風險溢價便可能消退。
這種情境不一定需要中東局勢取得重大突破，只要沒有出現新的實質升級，就可能為市場帶來利多。除了有利於股債市場，也可能讓先前承受能源成本壓力的歐洲石油消費相關產業受惠。
Wilson補充，如果美國期中選舉結束後兩至三週內，局勢沒有出現實質升級，市場可能逐漸發現實際情況優於先前悲觀預期，單是這種預期落差，就足以成為市場的正面催化因素。
他也認同Schiffrin對短期利率的看法，認為目前市場定價仍高於合理預測水準。
主持人最後指出，如果能源風險消退、利率壓力緩解，股市年底前或有機會擺脫7700點附近的狹幅震盪。
不過，Wilson認為，若市場反彈，帶動行情的可能是先前遭到大幅拋售的個股，而不一定是所有類股同步上漲。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs analysts point out that global artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investment is entering a new phase, and the market’s optimistic expectations for tech giants’ capital expenditures are beginning to be tested. With cloud providers’ earnings reports showing divergence, whether AI investment can smoothly translate into revenue and profit has become a focal point for the market.

On the other hand, there remains a gap between the Federal Reserve’s policy path and market interest rate pricing. Goldman Sachs believes the market may overestimate the magnitude of future rate hikes, and global short-term rates could decline before year‑end. Whether the equity‑bond market can escape recent volatility depends on whether the Middle East situation escalates further and whether energy prices fall.

In Goldman Sachs’ latest market discussion program “Brace the Game,” the host exchanged views with Goldman Sachs Global Risk Manager Josh Schiffrin and senior research advisor Dominic Wilson on Fed policy, AI investment trends, energy risk, and year‑end market positioning.

The Fed’s rate hike magnitude may be lower than market expectations. Regarding the Fed’s latest decision, Schiffrin said the meeting’s outcome largely met expectations and reflected the policy signals released before the meeting. Despite persistent inflationary pressure, the Fed still has room to observe more economic data before deciding on future policy direction.

He noted that the Fed Chair mentioned that the policy measures taken in September have begun to take effect. The financial environment has not yet reached full tightening, but it has indeed tightened somewhat. This keeps him in a relatively dovish stance on future Fed policy.

The market currently reflects a potential additional hike of 60 to 65 basis points, but Josh believes the Fed’s actual hike may be lower than market pricing. The baseline expectation is a hike in December, after which the current round of hikes may end.

Wilson pointed out that recent rate declines have several reasons. First, some sovereign bond markets and high‑yield credit bonds are starting to feel pressure, indicating that previous rate levels have burdened different parts of the financial system.

Second, rates had previously risen to levels that are difficult to sustain. Looking at overnight index swap (OIS) forward pricing, the 10‑year forward rate once touched about 5.2%, close to the high point of the past 20‑year policy rate cycle, indicating that the market has priced in a high risk premium.

In addition, the recent weakening of AI‑concept stocks has led the market to reassess economic growth prospects. Wilson believes this market shift shows that growth momentum and concerns about economic slowdown could affect Treasury yields more than initially expected.

AI capital expenditure growth may peak, monetization capability is key. Regarding AI investment trends, Wilson said the market’s view on this theme is becoming more complex. Over the past few years, AI has been the most sought‑after investment theme, but as some sectors become overvalued, investors need to maintain a fairly optimistic outlook on future growth to justify the prices of related companies and infrastructure stocks.

Today, the signals the market receives are no longer overwhelmingly bullish. From the latest earnings, tech giants’ performance is diverging, and Goldman Sachs also expects the peak of the AI investment boom to be close.
Wilson emphasized that this does not mean AI investment will stop; there will still be substantial capital flowing into the sector, but the growth rate of capital expenditure may soon reach its peak.

Moreover, the financing scale required for AI infrastructure investment is huge, and the credit market has begun to show signs of weakness. How hyperscalers will convert massive investments into actual revenue and profit remains questionable.

He believes that when the AI industry’s growth story changes, coupled with rising rates and widening credit spreads, the market will shift from chasing growth to evaluating traditional corporate fundamentals. The risk‑reward profile of AI investment will thus become more symmetrical, no longer the super‑theme that dominated the past three years.
The host noted that over the past six months, the market has been constrained by macro factors such as rates, energy prices, and credit conditions, yet corporate earnings have shown resilience.

Looking at this quarter’s earnings, overall performance is decent, but the market’s original threshold was high, and forward earnings estimates have not been revised upward as dramatically as in the first and second quarters. Excluding private equity, corporate earnings growth could reach the late‑20% range, even exceeding 30%.
However, current earnings performance mainly meets the market’s existing expectations and is not yet a catalyst to drive the stock market higher again.

Middle East situation and oil prices are the biggest variables for the year‑end market. Looking ahead to year‑end, Schiffrin says the Middle East escalation is the most concerning threat. If conflict expands and drives energy prices up again, it will be the biggest short‑term risk for financial markets.
Conversely, if the situation eases and oil prices fall, it will help improve inflation prospects, ease central banks’ rate‑hike pressure, and be a positive for stocks and bonds.

In year‑end investment positioning, Schiffrin is most optimistic about short‑term rates falling. He believes the market’s current pricing of rate hikes exceeds what central banks might actually take, and similar situations exist for US, European, and UK rate pricing.
Furthermore, if market concerns about credit risk rise or investors adjust expectations of the central bank policy path, it could further push short‑term rates down.
Wilson believes the market has already priced in a significant risk premium for a potential Middle East escalation, especially as the oil market reflects real geopolitical risk.

He pointed out that although there is still a possibility of escalation in November, if the conflict does not worsen further or the actual situation does not reach the market’s most pessimistic expectations, the risk premium in energy prices may fade.

This scenario does not necessarily require a major breakthrough in the Middle East; as long as there is no new substantive escalation, it could be a positive for the market. Besides benefiting the equity‑bond market, it could also help European oil‑dependent industries that have been under energy‑cost pressure.

Wilson added that if, within two to three weeks after the US midterm elections, the situation does not see substantive escalation, the market may gradually realize that the actual situation is better than previously pessimistic expectations, and that expectation gap alone could be a positive catalyst for the market.
He also agrees with Schiffrin on short‑term rates, believing that current market pricing remains above reasonable forecast levels.
The host concluded that if energy risk fades and rate pressure eases, the stock market could potentially break out of the narrow 7,700‑point range before year‑end.
However, Wilson believes that if the market rebounds, the rally may be driven by individual stocks that were heavily sold earlier, rather than a simultaneous rise across all sectors.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone Duo暫無召回計畫！緊急下發售後指引、但換機仍面臨缺貨
items.title_en: Apple iPhone Duo Has No Recall Plan Yet; Urgent After‑Sales Guidance Issued, Yet Replacement Still Faces Stock Shortages
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊iPhone Duo上市後接連傳出內螢幕沿摺痕開裂問題，如今官方進一步要求全美Apple Store及第三方授權維修中心，針對相關故障採取統一檢測與售後處理流程。
根據相關報導，蘋果本週已向旗下零售門市及第三方授權服務供應商發布專項操作指引，要求技術人員收到iPhone Duo內螢幕開裂通報後，必須依照統一程序進行檢測與確認，確認故障後再按照標準售後流程提供維修或更換全新設備。
蘋果在內部指引中仍維持先前的公開說法，強調目前只有極少數iPhone Duo出現內螢幕故障，並未大規模擴散。
此前蘋果曾表示，首批使用者對產品的整體回饋良好，開發者也正加快應用程式適配新機型。
對於遇到螢幕故障的用戶，蘋果建議直接聯繫官方客服AppleCare，申請免費更換。
不過，業界人士認為，蘋果此次向全通路售後據點下發統一作業規範，可能反映實際故障處理需求已超出原先預期，否則未必需要全面建立標準化處理程序。
蘋果官方明確表示，目前沒有針對iPhone Duo的內屏故障推出整機召回的相關計劃，截至目前也還沒有在官方網站上針對這個問題發布面向公眾公開的專屬維修保障方案。

iPhone Duo換機不易 售後預約與庫存成問題

iPhone Duo上市不到幾天，便有部分用戶反映內螢幕出現裂痕。相關案例包括正常展開手機時出現異響，以及螢幕沿中央摺痕裂開，讓產品耐用性受到質疑。
部分用戶表示，故障是在正常展開過程中發生，並非手機摔落或受到外力撞擊，因而引發外界對摺疊結構及螢幕可靠性的關注。
蘋果承認少量設備存在內螢幕故障後，雖提供AppleCare免費換機管道，但實際處理過程並不順利。
據媒體報導，美國維吉尼亞州一名用戶表示，當地門市確認故障屬於產品缺陷，但因售後預約額滿，他只能轉往另一家門市接受檢測，後續又因缺貨而持續等待。
中國瀋陽一名短影音創作者也表示，前往蘋果售後據點時，甚至被告知即使願意付費也無法維修，原因是門市缺乏相關零件，且無法確定到貨時間，只能先行登記。
分析人士指出，摺疊手機的技術挑戰並不會因蘋果加入市場而消失。除了產品耐用性，故障處理效率、售後服務、軟體適配及消費者對摺疊機型的接受程度，都將影響iPhone Duo後續市場表現。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) ’s first foldable iPhone Duo has been plagued by reports of internal‑screen cracks along the fold line since launch, and the company is now requiring all U.S. Apple Stores and third‑party authorized repair centers to follow a unified inspection and after‑sales handling process for the issue.

According to reports, Apple this week sent a special operating guide to its retail outlets and third‑party authorized service providers, instructing technicians that when they receive a report of an iPhone Duo internal‑screen crack they must follow a standardized procedure to test and verify the fault, and once confirmed provide repair or a brand‑new replacement according to the normal after‑sales workflow.

Apple’s internal guide still echoes its earlier public statement, emphasizing that only a very small number of iPhone Duo units have shown internal‑screen problems and that the issue has not spread widely.
Apple previously said that the first batch of users gave overall positive feedback on the product and that developers are accelerating app adaptation for the new model.
For users who encounter a screen fault, Apple advises contacting AppleCare directly to request a free replacement.

However, industry observers note that Apple’s decision to issue a uniform operating standard to all after‑sales locations may indicate that the actual volume of fault handling has exceeded original expectations, otherwise a comprehensive standardized procedure would not be necessary.

Apple explicitly states that there is currently no plan to recall iPhone Duo units for internal‑screen defects, and no public repair‑guarantee program for this issue has been posted on its website to date.

iPhone Duo replacement is difficult; after‑sales appointments and inventory are problematic. Within days of launch, some users reported internal‑screen cracks, including abnormal noises when the phone is unfolded and cracks along the central fold, raising doubts about durability.
Some users said the failure occurred during normal unfolding, not from drops or impacts, prompting external concern over the folding mechanism and screen reliability.
After Apple acknowledged a small number of devices with internal‑screen faults and offered a free AppleCare replacement channel, the actual handling process proved cumbersome.

Media reports cite a user in Virginia, USA, who said the local store confirmed the defect but, because after‑sales appointments were fully booked, he had to go to another store for inspection and then faced further delays due to stock shortages.

A short‑video creator in Shenyang, China, said that when visiting an Apple service point he was told that even if he paid, the repair could not be performed because the store lacked the necessary parts and had no ETA for arrival, so he could only register his case.

Analysts point out that the technical challenges of foldable phones will not disappear just because Apple enters the market. Beyond product durability, the efficiency of fault handling, after‑sales service, software adaptation, and consumer acceptance of foldable devices will all affect the iPhone Duo’s future market performance.

items.title: Alliant拚半年新增1GW資料中心用電合約，資本支出仍有上調空間
items.title_en: Alliant Aims to Secure 1GW of New Data Center Power Contracts in Six Months, Capital Expenditure Still Has Upside
paras: 2026年11月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國電力公司Alliant Energy(LNT-US)於法說會表示，預期未來六個月可再取得約1GW大型用電客戶合約，為後續電力建設帶來新增投資需求。目前旗下公用事業已簽約的資料中心用電需求達3.4GW，公司並將2027至2030年四年資本支出計畫提高至159億美元（約新台幣5,164億元），較前一版四年計畫增加19%。
新增合約與實際用電之間仍有時間差。公司預估，下一批約1GW需求將在2029至2030年開始逐步增加，用來支應需求的燃氣發電設施，預計約在2030至2031年投入。因此，相關投資一部分會落在目前四年計畫內，另一部分則延續至2031年以後。
財務長Robert Durian表示，每增加1GW用電需求，約需新增20億至30億美元（約新台幣650億至974億元）資本支出，主要投入滿足客戶供電容量需求的設備。公司會配合客戶用電增加的時程安排發電設施，讓建設完成後的供電與現金流同步銜接。
Alliant也提高新專案納入投資計畫的門檻。除了簽署供電合約，還須確認土地、輸電、發電及地方許可等條件。這使得目前的資本支出計畫尚未包含所有洽談中的機會，後續仍將隨專案進度調整。

paras_en: November 1, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – U.S. utility Alliant Energy (LNT-US) said at its earnings call that it expects to win roughly 1 GW of large‑scale power contracts for data centers over the next six months, creating new investment demand for future power construction. The utility’s existing data‑center power contracts already total 3.4 GW, and the company has raised its 2027‑2030 four‑year capital‑expenditure plan to $15.9 billion (about NT$5,164 billion), a 19% increase over the previous plan.

There is a lag between signing contracts and actual power consumption. Alliant estimates that the next batch of about 1 GW of demand will start to ramp up gradually in 2029‑2030, and the gas‑fired generation facilities needed to meet that demand are expected to come online around 2030‑2031. Consequently, part of the related investment will fall within the current four‑year plan, while the remainder will extend beyond 2031.

Chief Financial Officer Robert Durian said that each additional 1 GW of power demand requires roughly $2‑3 billion (about NT$65‑97.4 billion) of capital spending, mainly for equipment to satisfy the customers’ supply‑capacity needs. The company will align the timing of new generation facilities with customers’ consumption schedules so that power delivery and cash flow are synchronized once construction is completed.

Alliant also raised the threshold for new projects to be included in its investment plan. In addition to signing power‑supply agreements, projects must now meet land, transmission, generation and local‑permit requirements. This means the current capital‑expenditure plan does not yet cover all opportunities under negotiation and will be adjusted as projects progress.

items.title: iPhone Duo螢幕裂開原因已找到？iFixit拆機揭「這一點」成關鍵
items.title_en: iPhone Duo Screen Cracks: iFixit Identifies a Key Factor
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊iPhone原被視為新任執行長特納斯（John Ternus）上任後的代表性產品，未料上市僅4天便傳出螢幕沿摺痕開裂，迫使蘋果啟動換機服務。不過，拆解專家已從鉸鏈結構找到可能的故障原因。
根據《財富》報導，iPhone Duo起售價1,999美元，10月23日開賣。部分首批買家反映，該機7.6吋內螢幕沿鉸鏈位置出現了裂紋，有些甚至在開箱數小時內便已經開裂。
根據《路透》報導，受損區域集中在內螢幕下方，靠近中央支撐桿，正好位於顯示器排線穿過的位置下方。
對此，拆解機構iFixit近日拆解iPhone Duo，利用電腦斷層掃描（CT）、拆解影像及蘋果專利資料，重建鉸鏈結構的3D模型，並比對用戶回報的螢幕故障位置。
iFixit研判，螢幕裂開其中一種可能原因是手機闔上時，支撐桿未能完全縮回，因而對螢幕施加壓力。
此外，外力擠壓、異物卡入、反覆彎折及製造瑕疵，也都可能造成損壞，目前仍需進一步調查。蘋果尚未針對這些分析結果置評。
iPhone Duo的鉸鏈結構相當複雜，蘋果稱其中包含超過100個零組件。根據《CNBC》報導，iFixit執行長Kyle Wiens指出，任何細微的製造偏差，甚至一粒沙子，都可能破壞鉸鏈原本用來保護的脆弱螢幕。
iFixit的灰塵測試也發現，儘管iPhone Duo具備IP68防塵防水等級，細小顆粒仍可能進入鉸鏈機構，導致手機開闔時發出異音，顯示活動式鉸鏈並未完全密封。
不過，iFixit對這款手機的可維修性評價相對正面，暫時給予5分（滿分10分），是該機構迄今對摺疊手機給出的最高分。

多名用戶回報螢幕開裂 拆解機構鎖定鉸鏈結構

目前，社群平台Reddit及《MacRumors》論壇已出現多起螢幕損壞照片。從流傳影像來看，裂痕多集中在內螢幕中央鉸鏈摺線附近，部分裝置還伴隨一道持續發亮的白色線。
科技網站《Tom"s Guide》也指出，有用戶發現螢幕右側出現明顯白線。
一名澳洲用戶表示，手機使用約6小時、開闔不到20次，內螢幕就已經開裂。科技媒體《Notebookcheck》引述該用戶說法指出，螢幕受損前，手機曾傳出明顯的碎裂聲。
目前故障規模仍難以確認。《彭博》週一報導，相關投訴數量正在增加；9to5Mac截至上週日則已統計約10起獨立案例。
不過，《MacRumors》提醒，網路上部分流傳照片可能由人工智慧（AI）生成，而正式上市前參與測試的評測人員，也沒有回報類似問題。

蘋果提供免費換機 保外維修費高達999美元

面對故障通報，蘋果表示，大多數iPhone Duo並未受到影響，若用戶發現內螢幕故障，可聯繫AppleCare申請更換，即使沒有訂閱AppleCare+，仍可獲得換機服務。透過電信業者購買的用戶，也應直接聯繫AppleCare。
目前，受影響用戶可前往蘋果直營門市辦理換機，但由於庫存有限，部分消費者仍須等待。蘋果尚未說明螢幕開裂的具體原因，也沒有公布是否推出後續修復方案或召回措施。
值得注意的是，若裝置超出保固期限，維修成本相當高。蘋果公布的iPhone Duo內螢幕保外維修費用為999美元，約為新機起售價的一半。
iFixit比較發現，這項維修費用明顯高於三星Galaxy Z Fold 8及Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold，後兩款手機的同類維修價格約為419至579美元。
不過，首批購買者目前仍受到基本保固保障。Tom"s Guide指出，蘋果提供的一年有限保固涵蓋正常使用情況下發生的產品瑕疵，消費者另享有14天退貨期限。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) first foldable iPhone was initially seen as the flagship product of new CEO John Ternus, but just four days after launch reports of screen cracks along the fold line forced Apple to launch a replacement program. However, teardown experts have pinpointed a possible failure cause in the hinge structure.

According to Fortune, the iPhone Duo launched at $1,999 on October 23. Some early buyers reported cracks appearing along the 7.6‑inch inner screen near the hinge, with a few devices cracking within hours of unboxing.
Reuters reported that the damaged area is concentrated on the lower part of the inner screen, near the central support bar, directly beneath where the display flex cable passes through.

In response, teardown firm iFixit recently disassembled the iPhone Duo, using CT scans, teardown footage and Apple patent documents to rebuild a 3‑D model of the hinge and compare it with user‑reported screen failure locations.
iFixit judges that one possible cause of the screen cracking is that the support bar does not fully retract when the phone is closed, thereby applying pressure to the display.
External pressure, foreign objects, repeated flexing and manufacturing defects could also cause damage, and further investigation is needed. Apple has not commented on these findings.

The iPhone Duo’s hinge is extremely complex, with Apple saying it contains over 100 components. CNBC cited iFixit CEO Kyle Wiens saying that even a tiny manufacturing deviation—or a single grain of sand—could compromise the delicate screen the hinge is meant to protect.

iFixit’s dust tests also found that, despite the iPhone Duo’s IP68 rating, tiny particles can still enter the hinge, causing audible noises when opening or closing and indicating the moving hinge is not fully sealed.
Nevertheless, iFixit gave the device a relatively positive repairability score, temporarily rating it 5 out of 10, the highest score the firm has awarded to any foldable phone so far.

Multiple users have reported screen cracks, and teardown analysts have zeroed in on the hinge structure. Reddit and the MacRumors forum now host numerous photos of damaged screens, most showing cracks near the central hinge crease of the inner display, with some devices also showing a persistent white line.
Tom’s Guide also noted that some users see a distinct white line on the right side of the screen.

An Australian user said the phone cracked after about six hours of use and fewer than 20 open‑close cycles. Notebookcheck quoted the user saying the phone made a clear shattering sound before the screen was damaged.
The scale of the problem remains unclear. Bloomberg reported on Monday that complaint numbers are rising; 9to5Mac counted roughly ten separate cases as of last Sunday.
MacRumors warned that some of the images circulating online may be AI‑generated, and reviewers who tested the device before launch have not reported similar issues.
Apple offers free replacements; even users without AppleCare+ can request a swap through AppleCare, and those who bought the phone through carriers should also contact AppleCare directly.

Affected users can visit Apple retail stores for a replacement, but limited inventory means some may have to wait. Apple has not disclosed the exact cause of the cracks nor announced any repair program or recall.
It’s worth noting that out‑of‑warranty repair costs are steep. Apple lists the out‑of‑warranty price for an iPhone Duo inner‑screen repair at $999, roughly half the device’s launch price.
iFixit found that this repair cost is significantly higher than those for the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold, which range from $419 to $579.

However, early buyers are still covered by the basic warranty. Tom’s Guide points out that Apple’s one‑year limited warranty covers defects under normal use, and consumers also enjoy a 14‑day return window.

items.title: AI退燒最危險的不是科技股 德銀警告美元恐掀拋售潮
items.title_en: The Biggest Risk of AI Cooling Isn’t Tech Stocks, Deutsche Bank Warns of a Dollar Sell‑off
paras: AI交易最危險的地方，或許不在科技股，而是在美元。德意志銀行警告，AI熱潮若退燒，恐引發美股與美元齊跌，迫使外國投資人增加匯率避險，進一步加重美元賣壓。海外資金持有逾20兆美元美股，下一輪AI拋售恐從科技股延燒至匯市。
根據德意志銀行估算，外國投資人持有的美國股票資產中，約90%的價值來自累積的價格上漲，而非實際淨買入。
這意味著，龐大的持股部位高度仰賴美股估值支撐，一旦股價大幅回落，資產價值也將隨之縮水。
更關鍵的是，流入美國股市的外國資金，目前已承擔美國經常帳赤字的全部融資需求，使美元與股票市場週期緊密相連。股市若出現大幅修正，支撐美元的資金來源也將直接承壓，讓原本集中在科技股的風險擴散至匯市。
美股跌 美元未必能護身
過去十年，美股下跌時，美元走強往往能替外國投資人抵銷部分損失。但這項保護機制有一個前提，就是衝擊來自美國以外。若風險源頭在美國本身，股票與美元可能同步走低，美元便未必能繼續充當損失的緩衝。
StoneX數據顯示，AI情緒與美元的5日滾動相關係數高達正0.97，20日相關係數則僅為正0.31，反映兩者短期走勢高度同步。
當AI信心動搖，美元也可能跟著承壓，而非像過去部分股市下跌期間一樣，提供避險保護。
因此，這次AI交易的風險不只在於科技股能否守住估值，也在於美元的傳統避險作用是否仍然有效。
不賣股票 也可能加重美元賣壓
對未進行匯率避險的外國投資人而言，美股與美元齊跌，意味著股票虧損之外，還得承受匯損。這種雙重打擊，可能促使投資人重新檢視美股部位的匯率風險。
即使他們沒有賣出股票，只是提高匯率避險比重，相關操作本身也會形成額外的美元賣壓，進一步壓低匯價。
德意志銀行警告，AI拋售潮可能在美股、匯率避險與美元之間形成危險循環。股匯同步下跌促使投資人增加避險，避險操作又加重美元跌勢，使市場承受的壓力超出單純股價回檔。
實質利率是關鍵判斷指標
要判斷這波波動只是部位調整，還是市場正重新評估AI繁榮週期，德意志銀行認為，美國實質利率是關鍵訊號。
該行指出，AI資本支出預期迅速膨脹，是推動美股與實質利率同步走高的重要因素之一。如果科技股、美元與美國實質利率一起下跌，便可能代表投資人開始將更疲弱的AI投資週期反映在價格中。
屆時，市場面對的將不只是科技股技術性修正，而是更廣泛的總體經濟重新定價。相反地，若實質利率維持高檔，股市調整就更可能仍屬部位層面的波動。
AI退燒 美元恐成另一個戰場
面對AI行情可能回檔，最直接的交易是放空科技股。但德意志銀行指出，較不顯眼、卻可能更具影響力的交易，是放空美元。
一旦以美國為中心的股市衝擊成真，外國投資人便可能被迫重新審視逾20兆美元股票資產的匯率避險策略，讓AI交易的影響從股市延伸至美元。
因此，納斯達克指數、美元指數(DXY) 與美國實質利率，將是觀察風險的三項重點。若三者同步走低，市場反映的疑慮可能遠超過一般部位出清，下一輪AI拋售也可能演變成美元拋售潮。
paras_en: The riskiest aspect of AI trading may not be tech stocks but the U.S. dollar. Deutsche Bank warns that if the AI hype cools, both U.S. equities and the dollar could fall together, forcing foreign investors to increase currency hedging and adding further selling pressure on the dollar. Overseas funds hold over $20 trillion of U.S. equities, and the next wave of AI sell‑offs could spread from tech stocks to the foreign‑exchange market.
Deutsche Bank estimates that about 90% of the value of foreign investors’ U.S. stock holdings comes from accumulated price gains rather than actual net purchases.
This means the massive stock positions are heavily dependent on equity valuations; a sharp drop in prices would shrink the asset value accordingly.

More critically, foreign capital flowing into U.S. equities now finances the entire U.S. current‑account deficit, tightly linking the dollar and the equity market cycle. A large equity correction would directly strain the dollar’s funding source, spreading risk from tech stocks to the FX market.
U.S. stocks fall, the dollar may not protect

In the past decade, a stronger dollar often offset part of foreign investors’ losses when U.S. stocks fell. That protection assumes the shock originates outside the United States. If the risk source is domestic, stocks and the dollar can decline together, and the dollar may no longer cushion losses.
StoneX data show the 5‑day rolling correlation between AI sentiment and the dollar is as high as +0.97, while the 20‑day correlation is only +0.31, indicating a tight short‑term sync.
When AI confidence wavers, the dollar can come under pressure too, rather than acting as a safe‑haven as it sometimes did during past equity downturns.
Thus, the risk of this AI trade lies not only in whether tech stocks can hold their valuations but also in whether the dollar’s traditional hedge function remains effective.
Not selling stocks can still add to dollar‑selling pressure

For foreign investors who have not hedged currency risk, a simultaneous drop in U.S. stocks and the dollar means they face both equity losses and foreign‑exchange losses. This double hit may prompt a reassessment of the FX risk in their U.S. equity holdings.
Even if they do not sell stocks but simply increase their hedging ratios, the hedging activity itself creates extra dollar‑selling pressure, pushing the exchange rate lower.

Deutsche Bank warns that an AI sell‑off could create a dangerous loop among equities, currency hedging and the dollar. A synchronized equity‑FX decline forces investors to hedge more, and the hedging adds to the dollar’s decline, making market stress exceed a simple equity pull‑back.
Real‑rate is the key gauge
To judge whether this volatility is merely a position adjustment or a market re‑evaluation of the AI boom cycle, Deutsche Bank says the U.S. real interest rate is the crucial signal.

The bank notes that rapidly expanding AI capital expenditures are a major driver of both equity gains and rising real rates. If tech stocks, the dollar and U.S. real rates fall together, it could signal investors are beginning to price in a weaker AI investment cycle.

In that case, the market would face not just a technical correction in tech stocks but a broader macro‑economic repricing. Conversely, if real rates stay high, the equity correction is more likely to be a position‑level swing.
AI cooling could make the dollar another battlefield
When the AI rally potentially retraces, the most direct trade is shorting tech stocks. However, Deutsche Bank points out that a less obvious but possibly more impactful trade is shorting the dollar.

If a U.S.-centric equity shock materialises, foreign investors may be forced to revisit hedging strategies for over $20 trillion of stock assets, extending AI‑related market impact from equities to the dollar.

Therefore, the Nasdaq index, the dollar index (DXY) and U.S. real rates will be the three key gauges of risk. If all three move lower together, market concerns could far exceed a routine position unwind, and the next AI sell‑off could turn into a dollar sell‑off.

items.title: 川普預告民主黨若奪國會多數將成「否決先生」！揚言否決法案逼朝野協商
items.title_en: Trump Warns That If Democrats Capture Congress Majority He’ll Become “Mr. Veto,” Threatening to Block Bills to Force Bipartisan Negotiation
paras: 美國總統川普表示，如果民主黨在週二（3日）的期中選舉中取得國會多數席次，他可能不得不成為「否決先生」（Mr. Veto）。
根據《彭博》報導，這段談話摘自《紐約郵報》（New York Post）對川普的專訪，相關片段於週日（1日）在《福斯新聞》（Fox News）播出。
川普表示：「他們會把法案送到我這裡，而你就否決它。等到一、兩個月內所有法案都遭到否決後，畢竟那純屬浪費時間，他們最終還是會過來尋求達成協議。」
川普週日預計前往堪薩斯州與愛荷華州舉行造勢活動，希望提高共和黨在期中選舉中保住國會控制權的機會。
民調顯示，川普目前的低支持度讓民主黨有機會贏得國會至少一個議院的控制權，甚至可能同時拿下參眾兩院。
川普表示：「希望我們不必為此擔心。」

paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said that if the Democratic Party wins a majority of seats in Congress in Tuesday’s (the 3rd) midterm elections, he may have to become “Mr. Veto.”
According to Bloomberg, the remarks come from a New York Post interview with Trump, and the clip aired on Fox News on Sunday (the 1st).
Trump said, “They’ll send bills to me and I’ll veto them. After a month or two of every bill being vetoed—because that would just be a waste of time—they’ll eventually come back seeking a deal.”
Trump is expected on Sunday to travel to Kansas and Iowa for campaign rallies, hoping to boost the Republican Party’s chances of retaining control of Congress in the midterms.
Polls show Trump’s currently low approval rating gives Democrats a chance to win control of at least one chamber of Congress, and possibly both the House and Senate.
Trump added, “Hopefully we won’t have to worry about that.”

items.title: 銅「到處都賣光」！美國囤貨推升中國進口溢價 AI疑慮卻壓抑期銅
items.title_en: Copper ‘Sold Out Everywhere’! US Stockpiling Boosts China Import Premium, AI Concerns Damp Futures Copper
paras: 中國銅市現貨供應吃緊，洋山銅溢價突破每公噸 200 美元，創下歷史新高。美國潛在關稅引發囤貨潮，將大量銅吸往美國，加上中國冶煉廠減產與庫存下降，使區域供應失衡加劇。不過，現貨難找並未阻止國際銅價回落，人工智慧 (AI) 投資前景疑慮與美國關稅政策的不確定性，正讓市場在眼前供應緊張與未來需求風險之間拉鋸。
《彭博》週四 (29 日) 報導，根據 Fastmarkets 自 2017 年以來的資料，洋山銅溢價週三攀升至每公噸 200 美元以上，刷新紀錄。這項指標反映中國買家為取得進口實體銅，願意在倫敦金屬交易所 (LME) 基準價格之上支付的額外費用。
上海大宗商品諮詢機構 Mysteel Global 銅分析師 Xiao Chuankang 形容，銅「到處都賣光了」，並預期供應稀缺將使溢價維持高檔。
然而，中國現貨供應吃緊，並不代表全球銅庫存全面不足。
《彭博》指出，全球總庫存並不低，但大量金屬集中在美國，壓縮其他地區可取得的貨源。交易商為搶在美國可能對精煉銅課徵關稅前布局，已將數十萬公噸銅運往美國。
《路透》報導，COMEX 倉庫銅庫存今年以來增加約 60%，達 800,321 短噸，約合 72.6 萬公噸。相較之下，中國庫存低於往年同期水準，冶煉廠也因成本壓力縮減生產，第三季精煉銅產量較去年同期下降 1.1%。
上海有色網 (SMM) 指出，截至 10 月 29 日，中國保稅區銅庫存較前週減少 1,200 公噸，降至 26,800 公噸。原料供應緊張、冶煉廠集中檢修，以及颱風造成物流與船期延誤，都限制短期貨源補充。
SMM 預期，短期可用供應緊張的局面難以明顯改善，後續須觀察冶煉廠恢復生產與進口銅到港的速度。倫敦現貨相對三個月期銅的逆價差擴大，也增加中國買家的進口成本壓力。
在中國庫存偏低之際，交易制度也出現變化。上海期貨交易所週四宣布，即日起暫停銅、鋁期貨保稅交割業務。
《彭博》引述知情人士指出，交易所向市場參與者說明，決定與相關業務參與度下降有關。
受訪交易人士則認為，這項措施可能有助於減緩套利交易帶動的金屬外流，降低中國供應進一步收緊的壓力。
不過，現貨溢價反映的是中國眼前取得實體銅的難度，國際期銅價格則同時受到未來需求預期牽動。因此，即使中國現貨供應吃緊，對 AI 投資前景的疑慮仍可能壓低期銅價格。
LME 三個月期銅週四在官方公開喊價交易中下跌 0.9%，至每公噸 14,345 美元，低於 9 月創下的 14,875 美元歷史高點。
市場對 AI 資料中心與電網建設的需求預期，是先前推升銅價的重要動力。但 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 財報揭露 AI 投資伴隨龐大現金消耗後，投資人對相關支出的回報與持續性轉趨審慎，也壓抑銅市情緒。
盛寶銀行大宗商品策略主管 Ole Hansen 警告，若 AI 題材賣壓加劇，可能壓抑市場對資料中心與電網建設所需原物料的需求預期，銅價今年高點或許已經出現。不過，他仍預期，未來一年銅價可望上漲約 10%，期間走勢將持續震盪。
摩根大通分析師 Patrick Jones 指出，市場情緒目前是轉趨謹慎，尚未全面看空。另一項主要下行風險，是美國最終未對精煉銅課徵關稅。屆時，提前將銅運往美國的誘因可能減弱，其他地區的供應壓力也有望緩解，逐步讓中國買家重新取得議價空間。
中期而言，電力與資料中心建設需求仍為銅市提供支撐。SMM 引述世界銀行最新展望指出，世銀將 2027 年銅價全年均價預測較 4 月上調 18%，至每公噸 13,000 美元，反映新礦投產難以追上相關需求。
不過，這項預測仍略低於世銀估計的 2026 年全年均價 13,200 美元。世銀雖上修明年銅價預測，仍預期全年均價將較今年小幅回落。

paras_en: China's copper spot market is tight, with the Yangshan copper premium breaking $200 per tonne, a historic high. Potential US tariffs have sparked a stockpiling wave, pulling large volumes of copper to the United States, while Chinese smelters cut output and inventories, worsening regional supply imbalances. Yet the difficulty in finding spot copper has not stopped international copper prices from falling, as doubts over AI investment prospects and uncertainty about US tariff policy are pulling the market between current supply tightness and future demand risk.

Bloomberg reported on Thursday (the 29th) that, according to Fastmarkets data dating back to 2017, the Yangshan copper premium rose above $200 per tonne on Wednesday, setting a new record. The metric reflects the extra amount Chinese buyers are willing to pay above the London Metal Exchange (LME) benchmark price to secure physical imported copper.
Mysteel Global copper analyst Xiao Chuankang described the situation as copper being “sold out everywhere” and expects the scarcity to keep the premium at elevated levels.
However, tight spot supply in China does not mean global copper inventories are universally low.

Bloomberg noted that global total inventories are not low, but a large share of metal is concentrated in the United States, compressing the supply available to other regions. Traders, trying to position before the US might impose tariffs on refined copper, have already shipped hundreds of thousands of tonnes to the US.

Reuters reported that COMEX warehouse copper inventories have risen about 60% year‑to‑date to 800,321 short tons, roughly 726,000 tonnes. By contrast, Chinese inventories are below year‑on‑year levels, and smelters have cut production under cost pressure, with third‑quarter refined copper output down 1.1% from a year earlier.

Shanghai Metals Market (SMM) said that as of October 29, copper inventories in China's bonded zones fell by 1,200 tonnes from the previous week to 26,800 tonnes. Tight raw material supplies, concentrated smelter maintenance, and typhoon‑induced logistics and vessel delays are all limiting short‑term replenishment.

SMM expects the short‑term tight supply situation to remain difficult to improve markedly, and future observations will need to focus on how quickly smelters resume production and imported copper arrives at ports. The widening reverse basis between London spot and three‑month futures also adds cost pressure for Chinese buyers.

Amid low Chinese inventories, trading rules are also changing. The Shanghai Futures Exchange announced on Thursday that, effective immediately, bonded delivery of copper and aluminum futures is suspended.
Bloomberg quoted insiders saying the exchange explained the decision was linked to a decline in participation in the related business.
Interviewed traders believe the measure could help curb metal outflows driven by arbitrage trading, easing pressure on China’s already tightening supply.

Nevertheless, the spot premium reflects the immediate difficulty for China to obtain physical copper, while international futures prices are also driven by future demand expectations. Thus, even with tight spot supply in China, lingering doubts about AI investment prospects could still depress futures copper prices.
LME three‑month copper fell 0.9% on Thursday in the official open‑outcry session to $14,345 per tonne, below the September all‑time high of $14,875.

Market expectations for AI data‑center and grid‑building demand had previously been a key driver of copper price gains. However, after Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) disclosed that AI investments consume massive cash, investors have become more cautious about the returns and sustainability of such spending, dampening sentiment in the copper market.

Saxo Bank commodities strategist Ole Hansen warned that if AI‑related selling pressure intensifies, it could suppress market expectations for the raw‑material demand of data centers and grid projects, meaning copper’s peak this year may already have passed. Still, he expects copper to rise about 10% over the next year, with the price likely to remain volatile in the meantime.

JPMorgan analyst Patrick Jones said market sentiment is currently shifting toward caution but is not yet uniformly bearish. Another major downside risk is that the US ultimately does not impose tariffs on refined copper. If that happens, the incentive to ship copper to the US early would weaken, easing supply pressure elsewhere and gradually giving Chinese buyers more bargaining power again.

In the medium term, power‑generation and data‑center construction demand will continue to underpin the copper market. SMM cited the World Bank’s latest outlook, which raised its 2027 full‑year copper price forecast by 18% from April to $13,000 per tonne, reflecting the difficulty of bringing new mines online fast enough to meet demand.

However, that forecast remains slightly below the World Bank’s own estimate for the 2026 full‑year average of $13,200 per tonne. While the Bank has lifted its next‑year copper price outlook, it still expects the annual average to slip modestly from this year’s level.

items.title: 伊朗與卡達連續3天談判！擬美伊達成協議後48小時內重開荷姆茲海峽
items.title_en: Iran and Qatar negotiate for three consecutive days! Plan to reopen the Hormuz Strait within 48 hours if a US‑Iran deal is reached
paras: 一名了解談判情況的官員表示，伊朗談判代表週日（1日）在杜哈與卡達斡旋代表展開連續第三天會談，目的是推動達成結束美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭的協議。
根據《路透》報導，伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araqchi）週日表示，目前持續推進中的談判，目的是與卡達斡旋代表繼續磋商，並強調德黑蘭已做好「防禦與外交」兩手準備。
阿拉格齊接受伊朗國營媒體訪問時指出，雙方仍在討論一項「兩天提案」，但尚未達成最終結論。
卡達半島電視台（Al Jazeera）引述阿拉格齊週六（31日）接受訪問時的說法報導，伊朗與卡達談判代表已擬定一項方案，若伊朗與華府達成協議，荷姆茲海峽將可在兩天內重新開放。
此次談判正值外界憂心戰事可能在11月3日美國期中選舉後再度升級之際。
美國總統川普表示，美國不會在投票前對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊，並稱與德黑蘭的談判已有進展，但他並未排除選舉結束後進一步採取軍事行動的可能性。
隨著這場已持續8個月的戰爭持續干擾全球石油供應，並蔓延至中東各地，伊朗多次表示，若再遭受攻擊，將打擊部署在鄰近國家的美國與以色列目標。
阿拉格齊談及與卡達官員的談判時表示：「我們正盡最大努力推動這項進程，希望對方也能保持理性，優先選擇外交途徑，而非其他方式。」
伊朗最高領袖穆吉塔巴（Mojtaba Khamenei）週六下令武裝部隊做好應對任何攻擊的準備，軍方隨後也宣布採取措施，進一步強化戰備。
美國國務卿盧比歐（Marco Rubio）週六表示，川普尚未決定是否對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊，但他傾向透過外交途徑解決這場衝突。
一名官員先前向《路透》透露，卡達斡旋代表週五（30日）曾前往德黑蘭與伊朗官員會談，之後於週六將談判移至杜哈。該官員補充，相關談判也透過與華府的定期聯繫進行協調。
paras_en: An official familiar with the talks said Iran's negotiating team held a third consecutive day of meetings in Doha with Qatar's mediation representatives on Sunday (the 1st), aiming to push forward an agreement to end the war between the United States and Israel against Iran.

According to Reuters, Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araqchi said on Sunday that the ongoing negotiations are intended to continue discussions with Qatar's mediation team, and emphasized that Tehran is prepared on both "defense and diplomacy" fronts.
In an interview with state‑run media, Araqchi noted that the parties are still discussing a "two‑day proposal," but no final conclusion has been reached yet.

Al Jazeera, citing Araqchi's remarks on Saturday (the 31st), reported that Iran and Qatar's negotiating teams have drafted a plan under which the Strait of Hormuz could be reopened within two days if Iran reaches an agreement with Washington.
The talks come at a time when outside observers are worried that the conflict could flare up again after the U.S. midterm elections on November 3.

U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not launch a new round of attacks on Iran before the vote, and claimed that negotiations with Tehran have made progress, though he did not rule out the possibility of further military action after the election.

As the eight‑month‑long war continues to disrupt global oil supplies and spread across the Middle East, Iran has repeatedly warned that any further attacks would target U.S. and Israeli assets stationed in neighboring countries.

Speaking about the talks with Qatari officials, Araqchi said, "We are making every effort to advance this process and hope the other side will also act rationally, prioritizing diplomatic routes rather than other means."
Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered the armed forces on Saturday to be ready to respond to any attack, and the military subsequently announced measures to further strengthen its readiness.

U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that Trump has not yet decided whether to launch a new round of attacks on Iran, but he leans toward resolving the conflict through diplomatic channels.

An official previously told Reuters that Qatar's mediation representative visited Tehran on Friday (the 30th) for talks with Iranian officials, and then moved the negotiations to Doha on Saturday. The official added that the talks are also being coordinated through regular contacts with Washington.

items.title: 步法國後塵 德國多地示威引發暴力騷亂
items.title_en: Following France's Footsteps, Protests Spark Violence Across Germany
paras: 德國法蘭克福市中心31日（周六）晚間爆發暴力衝突，多家商鋪遭洗劫，當日柏林、科隆、漢堡等主要城市也發生由示威活動引發的暴力事件。
當天早些時候，數千名遊行者在法蘭克福舉行大體和平的示威活動。本次活動由倡議團體「Z世代做主」組織，訴求包括反對學校經費不足、抗議生活成本高昂、公共開支削減以及義務兵役制。
法蘭克福警方當日晚間通報，市中心發生暴力騷亂，特種警力已經部署到位。警方稱，示威者向應急人員投擲煙花、石塊與玻璃瓶，警方動用高壓水炮驅散人群。
當晚法蘭克福主要商業街一大片區域被警方封鎖。警方表示，多家商店櫥窗被砸，還有人向應急救援人員投擲燃燒瓶，該市實施了大量逮捕，從當日夜間到次日凌晨，該市局勢逐步平復。
當地有關部門表示，一家槍械店的櫥窗遭到破壞，警方逮捕嫌疑人後查獲兩件武器。還有人闖入其他店鋪，搶走運動鞋等商品。
德國其它城市在示威之後，也出現類似衝突。
科隆警方稱，警員在主火車站附近遭襲，有人向警方投擲玻璃瓶，還推撞自行車。柏林警方通報，晚間發生的暴力示威造成27名警員受傷，最多56人被臨時扣留。漢堡有身著黑衣人員燃放煙花、點燃路障，共120人被捕。
德國內政部長多布林特1日表示，警方阻止了數周前巴黎那種規模的暴力場面。他呼籲對騷亂者和搶劫者施以重刑。
據法蘭克福、慕尼黑、柏林政府統計，參與示威的人數多達1.8萬人，約為組織者在官網預估人數的一半。組織方數據則顯示，活動覆蓋柏林、法蘭克福、漢堡、慕尼黑等34座城市，約12萬人參與。
「Z世代做主」發言人弗里德里希表示，示威的目的是「爭取和平與自由，而非戰爭與強制」，「我們最看重的是醫療與教育體系獲得更多支持。我們反對義務兵役，希望負擔能夠得到更公平分配。」
法蘭克福所在的黑森州內政部長波塞克稱，大約100名「身份明確的左翼極端分子」混入抗議，抗議以這樣的方式收場令人「蒙羞」。
「我們都記得法國發生的畫面：洗劫、縱火焚燒房屋與警車、襲擊警員……法國的情況絕不能成為我們的範本。」波塞克說。
paras_en: On Saturday evening, November 31st, violent clashes erupted in downtown Frankfurt, with numerous shops looted. The same day, major cities such as Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg also saw violence stemming from protest activities.

Earlier that day, thousands of demonstrators gathered in Frankfurt for a largely peaceful march organized by the advocacy group “Gen Z Takes Charge,” demanding better school funding, protesting high living costs, cuts to public spending, and opposing compulsory military service.

Frankfurt police reported that violent riots broke out in the city centre that evening, prompting deployment of special police units. Police said protesters threw fireworks, stones and glass bottles at emergency personnel, and officers used high‑pressure water cannons to disperse the crowd.

A large section of Frankfurt’s main shopping street was cordoned off by police that night. Police said shop windows were smashed and some individuals hurled Molotov‑type bottles at rescue workers. Numerous arrests were made, and the situation gradually calmed from the night into the early hours of the next day.
Local authorities said a firearms store’s window was smashed; after arresting a suspect, police recovered two weapons. Others broke into additional stores, stealing items such as sneakers.
Similar clashes were reported in other German cities after the protests.

Cologne police said officers were attacked near the main train station, with glass bottles thrown and bicycles rammed. Berlin police reported that the evening’s violent demonstration injured 27 officers and temporarily detained up to 56 people. In Hamburg, men in black set off fireworks and ignited road barriers, leading to 120 arrests.

Interior Minister Nancy Faeser said on the 1st that police had prevented a scenario comparable to the large‑scale violence seen in Paris weeks earlier, and she called for harsh penalties for rioters and looters.

According to statistics from the governments of Frankfurt, Munich and Berlin, up to 18,000 people took part in the protests, roughly half of the number the organizers had estimated on their website. Organizers claim the events spanned 34 cities including Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg and Munich, with about 120,000 participants.

“Gen Z Takes Charge” spokesperson Friedrich said the protests aim to “fight for peace and freedom, not war and coercion,” adding, “Our top priorities are more support for healthcare and education. We oppose compulsory military service and want a fairer distribution of the burden.”
Hesse Interior Minister Peter Bleser said roughly 100 “identifiable left‑wing extremists” infiltrated the protests, calling the outcome “shameful.”
“We all remember the images from France: looting, arson of houses and police cars, attacks on officers… France’s situation must never become our model,” Bleser said.

items.title: 黑海戰事激烈 俄羅斯糧食出口被迫繞道北極
items.title_en: Intensified Black Sea Conflict Forces Russia's Grain Exports to Reroute via the Arctic
paras: 黑海戰事持續升級，迫使全球最大小麥出口國俄羅斯尋找新的出海口，甚至開始嘗試從北極圈內摩爾曼斯克港向非洲出口糧食。
據英國《金融時報》1日（周日）報導，俄烏雙方對黑海港口及船舶的襲擊不斷升級，俄羅斯傳統糧食出口通道受到嚴重干擾，不得不轉向波羅的海、北極港口等替代路線。
然而，這些路線不僅成本高昂，而且難以彌補黑海港口運力缺口。
俄羅斯糧食出口面臨的最大問題，已經不只是能否把糧食賣出去，而是還能否以有競爭力價格賣出去。
據《路透社》10月26日報導，航運數據顯示，今年9月俄羅斯海運糧食出口量較一年前驟降61.9%，降至約200萬噸。其中黑海和亞速海港口出口量僅30萬噸，狂降93.7%。
這一變化尤其值得注意，因為黑海原本是俄羅斯糧食出口絕對主力。
在2025年7月至2026年6月的上一出口季，俄羅斯通過黑海和亞速海港口出口糧食4,630萬噸，佔海運糧食出口總量近九成。
這些港口距離俄羅斯南部主要農業產區較近，又能夠經地中海直接連接中東、北非等核心市場，長期具有明顯運輸成本優勢。
但自今年7月新出口季開始以來，俄烏雙方不斷襲擊對方港口和商船，黑海航運風險急劇上升。8月俄羅斯重要出口港新羅西斯克的糧食裝卸作業一度因襲擊中斷。
對俄羅斯而言，黑海運輸受阻意味著長期建立的低成本糧食出口體系遭到衝擊，不得不另尋出路。
俄羅斯摩爾曼斯克商業港和糧食貿易商Demetra Holding在10月28日宣布，開始裝載首批3,400噸出口糧食。
《路透社》援引航運數據和市場消息稱，另有約2.8萬噸小麥計劃從摩爾曼斯克運往摩洛哥卡薩布蘭卡。
摩爾曼斯克位於北極圈內，距莫斯科近2,000公里。二戰期間，這裡曾是盟軍向蘇聯運送物資的港口，如今又被俄羅斯作為突破糧食運輸困境的新選擇。
問題在於，俄羅斯主要糧食產區集中在南部。原本可以就近運往黑海港口的小麥，如今需要先通過鐵路長途北運，再裝船出口。
烏克蘭情報單位10月初估計，這條路線可能使每噸糧食額外增加18至25美元運輸成本。
與此同時，《金融時報》指出，黑海航運運費已上漲至原來的兩倍以上。運輸費用增加壓縮了貿易商的利潤空間，也使俄羅斯農民面臨更大降價壓力。
糧食與石油不同，通常附加值較低，對運輸成本尤其敏感。即使俄羅斯糧食產量充足，如果出口成本持續上升，也可能出現糧食難以外運、國內收購價格下跌的局面。
更深遠的影響是，農民收入減少可能削弱下一季種植投入，進而影響未來糧食供應。
paras_en: The fighting in the Black Sea has escalated, forcing the world’s largest wheat exporter, Russia, to seek new sea routes and even begin trying to ship grain to Africa from the Arctic port of Murmansk within the Arctic Circle.

According to the Financial Times on Sunday the 1st, attacks on Black Sea ports and vessels by both Russia and Ukraine have intensified, severely disrupting Russia’s traditional grain export corridors and compelling a shift to alternative routes such as the Baltic and Arctic ports.
However, these routes are not only costly but also unable to make up for the capacity shortfall left by Black Sea ports.
The biggest problem facing Russian grain exports is no longer whether the grain can be sold, but whether it can be sold at a competitive price.

Reuters reported on October 26 that shipping data shows Russia’s maritime grain exports in September fell sharply by 61.9% year‑on‑year to about 2 million tonnes, with exports from Black Sea and Azov ports dropping to just 300,000 tonnes, a plunge of 93.7%.
This shift is especially noteworthy because the Black Sea has traditionally been the core outlet for Russian grain exports.

In the previous export season, July 2025 to June 2026, Russia shipped 46.3 million tonnes of grain through Black Sea and Azov ports, accounting for nearly nine‑tenths of its total maritime grain exports.

These ports are close to Russia’s main southern agricultural regions and provide direct Mediterranean links to core markets in the Middle East and North Africa, giving them a clear long‑term cost advantage.

But since the new export season began in July, repeated attacks on each other’s ports and merchant vessels have sharply raised Black Sea shipping risks, and in August grain loading at the key Russian export port of Novorossiysk was temporarily halted by an attack.
For Russia, the blockage of Black Sea transport means its long‑established low‑cost grain export system is under threat, forcing it to look for alternative pathways.
Russia’s Murmansk commercial port and grain trader Demetra Holding announced on October 28 that they had begun loading the first 3,400 tonnes of export grain.
Reuters, citing shipping data and market sources, said another roughly 28,000 tonnes of wheat is planned to be shipped from Murmansk to Casablanca, Morocco.

Murmansk lies within the Arctic Circle, about 2,000 km from Moscow. During World War II it served as an Allied supply port to the Soviet Union and is now being revived by Russia as a new solution to its grain‑shipping dilemma.

The problem is that Russia’s main grain‑producing regions are in the south. Wheat that once could be shipped directly to Black Sea ports now has to travel long distances north by rail before being loaded onto ships.
Ukrainian intelligence estimated in early October that this route could add an extra $18‑$25 per tonne in transportation costs.
At the same time, the Financial Times noted that Black Sea freight rates have more than doubled, squeezing traders’ margins and increasing price‑cut pressure on Russian farmers.

Grain, unlike oil, has relatively low added value and is especially sensitive to transport costs; even with ample production, rising export costs could make it difficult to ship abroad and depress domestic purchase prices.
The deeper impact is that reduced farmer incomes may curb investment in the next planting season, potentially affecting future grain supplies.

items.title: 40億美元德州園區計畫！經濟部助中小零組件廠赴美，AI供應鏈從整機組裝走向產業聚落
items.title_en: $4 B Texas Campus Project! Ministry of Economic Affairs Helps Small‑to‑Medium Component Makers Expand to the U.S., AI Supply Chain Shifts from Full‑System Assembly to an Industry Cluster
paras: 2026年11月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 台灣政府規劃與台灣區電機電子工業同業公會合作，在美國開發多座工業園區，協助中小型供應商赴美設廠，支援輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)及其他AI硬體業者的供應鏈。計畫將從德州起步，首座園區投資規模最高40億美元。
經濟部長龔明鑫表示，規劃中的美國園區不只一處，每座估計投資20億至40億美元。電電公會將負責籌資，政府則提供貸款保證，並協助處理簽證、土地取得等事宜，降低供應商赴美投資的門檻。目前首案仍在規劃與籌資階段，確切地點、進駐廠商及動工時程尚待公布。
這項計畫承接的是台灣大型伺服器廠已在德州展開的布局。當整機組裝與機櫃整合產線陸續到位，接下來需要補上的，是機殼、滑軌、電源與備援電力等周邊供應能力。對中小型業者而言，能否隨客戶赴美，除了訂單規模，也取決於能否負擔設廠初期的資金、人力與營運成本。
從既有布局來看，緯創(3231-TW)與緯穎(6669-TW)已進入實際出貨階段。緯創Fort Worth的D1廠已量產GB300產品，D2廠預計2027年具備運作條件；緯穎El Paso一廠已於2026年上半年量產，二廠規劃於2027年第二季加入營運。英業達(2356-TW)、和碩(4938-TW)與仁寶(2324-TW)也各自推進德州產線，量產與放量時程則有差異。
大型組裝廠先落地，讓周邊供應商有了就近設廠的需求基礎。勤誠(8210-TW)達拉斯量產廠預計2027年第三季量產；川湖(2059-TW)休士頓廠則已完成設備裝機並進入認證。電源方面，光寶科(2301-TW)在Plano已有BBU產線，McKinney新廠預計2027年上半年量產高壓直流供電(HVDC)與BBU產品，系統電(5309-TW)也在Plano建立生產據點。
這些投資說明，德州的台廠布局正由整機組裝向零組件延伸。園區若能吸引更多中小型供應商，才有機會把分散的生產據點，串成供料、打樣與交貨更完整的在地供應鏈。
客戶位置也是德州聚落形成的重要條件。戴爾Dell(DELL-US)總部位於Round Rock，惠普企業HPE(HPE-US)位於休士頓，供應商就近生產，有助於配合客戶交貨、產品調整與機櫃整合。
隨著多座新廠規劃於2027年開出產能，電力與人力將成為共同考驗。和碩德州廠曾因電力系統工程調整完工時程，英業達也另行投入電力工程。政府提供融資與行政協助，可望降低赴美門檻，園區後續仍須落實供電、招工與生產配套，才能配合組裝廠的拉貨節奏。

paras_en: Nov 1, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – The Taiwanese government, in partnership with the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Industries Association, plans to develop multiple industrial parks in the United States to help small‑ and medium‑sized suppliers set up factories and support NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and other AI‑hardware companies’ supply chains. The initiative will start in Texas, with the first park slated for up to $4 billion in investment.

Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑xin said the U.S. parks will not be limited to a single site, each projected to require $2‑4 billion. The association will raise capital, the government will provide loan guarantees and assist with visas, land acquisition and other matters to lower the entry barrier for suppliers. The first project is still in planning and fundraising; exact location, participating firms and construction timeline have yet to be announced.

The plan builds on the footprint already laid by Taiwan’s large server manufacturers in Texas. With full‑system assembly and rack‑integration lines coming online, the next gap to fill is the supply of chassis, rails, power units and backup power. For SMEs, the ability to follow customers to the U.S. depends not only on order size but also on whether they can afford the upfront capital, labor and operating costs of a new plant.

Based on existing deployments, Wistron (3231‑TW) and Wistron NeWeb (6669‑TW) are already shipping. Wistron’s Fort Worth D1 plant is mass‑producing the GB300, and D2 is expected to be operational in 2027; Wistron NeWeb’s El Paso plant began volume production in H1 2026, with a second plant slated to start in Q2 2027. Inventec (2356‑TW), Pegatron (4938‑TW) and Compal (2324‑TW) are also advancing Texas lines, though their mass‑production schedules differ.

The early arrival of large assembly plants creates a local demand base for nearby component makers. Qingsheng (8210‑TW) expects its Dallas plant to start volume production in Q3 2027; Chuanhu (2059‑TW) has completed equipment installation at its Houston site and is undergoing certification. In power supplies, Lite-On (2301‑TW) already runs a BBU line in Plano, and its new McKinney plant aims to mass‑produce high‑voltage DC (HVDC) and BBU products in H1 2027, while Powertech (5309‑TW) is establishing a production base in Plano as well.

These investments show Taiwan’s Texas presence moving from full‑system assembly toward component manufacturing. If the parks can attract more SMEs, scattered production sites could be linked into a more complete local supply chain for material provisioning, prototyping and delivery.

Customer location is another key factor in forming a Texas cluster. Dell’s headquarters are in Round Rock, and HPE’s in Houston, so nearby suppliers can better meet delivery schedules, product tweaks and rack integration needs.

With several new factories slated to come online in 2027, power and labor will be common challenges. Pegatron’s Texas plant previously adjusted its timeline due to power‑system work, and Inventec has also invested in power infrastructure. Government financing and administrative support should lower the U.S. entry barrier, but the parks must still secure power, recruit workers and provide production support to match the pull of assembly plants.
