items.title: 印尼擬收緊明年鎳礦配額  以防供給量過剩
items.title_en: Indonesia Plans to Tighten Nickel Ore Quotas Next Year to Prevent Oversupply
paras: 2026年11月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球最大鎳生產國印尼，考慮在2027年初收緊鎳礦生產配額，避免供給過剩持續壓低價格。印尼國家經濟委員會執行秘書Septian Hario Seto表示，明年第一季核定的配額，可能僅相當於今年產量的七至八成，待6至7月檢視需求後，再決定是否追加。
印尼今年已大幅調降鎳礦配額，從2025年的3.79億公噸，降至年初核定的2.6億至2.7億公噸，10月中旬再提高至2.9億公噸。明年仍可能延續先控制供給、再依需求增加配額的做法，避免產量擴張速度超過市場消化能力。
不過，限產尚未讓鎳價穩定走高。倫敦金屬交易所(LME)鎳現貨價格10月26日為每公噸15,372.56美元，較5月5日的近期高點下跌21%，僅比去年均價高出1.3%，仍低於2024年均價8.6%。
Seto於10月27日在菲律賓礦業會議指出，印尼不希望重演前兩年的價格重挫。鎳礦一旦開採出售，就無法收回，若持續擴產導致價格下跌，反而會降低資源收益，因此有必要透過配額調整供給。
但礦石供應收緊，也增加當地冶煉廠的經營壓力。部分在印尼設廠的中國業者，今年面臨礦源不足與礦石漲價，因而反對限產。對冶煉廠而言，國際鎳價能否獲得支撐是一回事，原料取得與採購成本則直接影響生產安排及獲利。
Seto表示，政府已向中國投資人說明，鎳市場供給過剩規模龐大，若繼續擴產，今年價格可能跌至每公噸1萬美元。他指出，部分業者已開始自行減產；明年若需求轉強，政府也會增加生產配額。

paras_en: On November 1, 2026 (Youshi Analysis / Industry Data Center report) – Indonesia, the world's largest nickel producer, is considering tightening nickel ore production quotas at the beginning of 2027 to avoid excess supply that continues to depress prices. Septian Hario Seto, Executive Secretary of the National Economic Committee, said the quotas approved for the first quarter of next year may amount to only 70‑80% of this year's production, and after reviewing demand in June‑July, a decision will be made on whether to add more.

Indonesia has already sharply reduced its nickel ore quota this year, cutting it from 379 million tonnes in 2025 to the 260‑270 million tonnes approved at the start of the year, and then raising it to 290 million tonnes in mid‑October. Next year it may continue the approach of first controlling supply and then increasing quotas according to demand, to prevent production growth from outpacing market absorption capacity.

However, the production cap has not yet stabilized nickel prices upward. On October 26, the LME nickel spot price was $15,372.56 per tonne, down 21% from the recent high on May 5, only 1.3% above last year's average, and still 8.6% below the 2024 average.

Seto told the Philippines Mining Conference on October 27 that Indonesia does not want to repeat the sharp price drops of the past two years. Once nickel ore is mined and sold it cannot be taken back; if production keeps expanding and prices fall, the revenue from the resource actually declines, making quota adjustments necessary to manage supply.

But tighter ore supply also raises operating pressure on local smelters. Some Chinese firms with plants in Indonesia have faced ore shortages and price hikes this year, prompting them to oppose the production limits. For smelters, whether international nickel prices are supported is one issue, while raw material availability and procurement costs directly affect production planning and profitability.

Seto said the government has explained to Chinese investors that the scale of oversupply in the nickel market is huge, and if expansion continues, prices could fall to $10,000 per tonne this year. He noted that some companies have already begun cutting output on their own; if demand strengthens next year, the government will also raise production quotas.

items.title: 美國期中選舉共和黨告急！民主黨領先逾8個百分點 眾議院恐易手、參議院也拉警報
paras: 美國期中選舉進入最後倒數，共和黨正面臨近年來最嚴峻的選情考驗。最新民調顯示，民主黨在國會通用選票中領先逾8個百分點，眾議院控制權可能易手，共和黨在參議院的多數優勢也面臨挑戰，部分原本被視為穩固的共和黨選區，如今也陷入激烈競爭。
根據媒體報導，兩黨競選策略人士及民調專家普遍認為，民主黨奪回共和黨掌控的眾議院機會較大。自美國總統川普上任以來，其支持率持續走低，加上民眾對生活成本上漲及伊朗戰爭的不滿升高，共和黨選情受到衝擊。
最新民調顯示，川普支持率僅40%，不滿意度達59%，創下自1990年開始進行中期選舉相關調查以來的最高紀錄。
參議院方面，共和黨目前以53席對47席領先，但民主黨正積極在阿拉斯加州、俄亥俄州及德州等傳統共和黨優勢州尋求突破。
對金融市場而言，國會控制權可能改變，意味著川普政府推動政策的阻力將增加，未來財政支出、貿易政策及監管環境的不確定性也可能隨之升高。
無黨派選情分析機構Inside Elections過去一週調整64場聯邦參眾議員及州長選舉的選情評級，其中63場調整有利民主黨，僅1場有利共和黨。

深紅州也陷入苦戰 共和黨被迫擴大防守範圍

共和黨選情壓力最明顯的跡象之一，是競選資源開始大量投入原本被視為勝券在握的選區，顯示傳統共和黨票倉也出現鬆動。
媒體報導指出，本月稍早一項民調顯示，共和黨候選人Anthony Constantino在紐約州一個鄉村選區落後民主黨對手4個百分點。然而，該選區在2024年總統大選時，曾以21個百分點的差距支持川普。
這項結果引起共和黨人士警覺，共和黨策略顧問Roger Stone隨即向白宮示警，建議安排副總統范斯（JD Vance）前往當地造勢，鞏固MAGA支持者，守住即將退休的眾議員Elise Stefanik留下的席位。范斯隨後也將該選區納入大選前最後一天的行程。
Cook Political Report預測，民主黨最可能在新一屆眾議院取得227至240席。眾議院總席次為435席，共和黨目前僅以219席對214席維持微弱多數。
民主黨眾議院競選委員會近期也持續向原本較安全的共和黨選區投入更多資源，顯示民主黨不僅希望奪回眾議院，也有意擴大競爭範圍。

年輕選民與無大學學歷白人流失 共和黨基本盤鬆動

《紐約時報》根據選民趨勢數據，以及七個參議院關鍵州的最新民調分析指出，共和黨正面臨多個核心選民群體支持度下滑的問題。
沒有大學學歷的白人選民長期是川普政治支持的重要基礎，但在絕大多數競爭激烈的州，共和黨參議院候選人的支持度都明顯低於川普2024年總統大選的勝選幅度。
由於這個族群除了德州及阿拉斯加州外，在其他所有參議院關鍵州都占多數，即使只有部分選民轉向，也可能對選情造成重大影響。近期民調顯示，共和黨在這個群體中的支持度已下滑兩位數，阿拉斯加州及堪薩斯州等傳統共和黨優勢州因此也被列入今年的競爭版圖。
年輕選民的變化同樣值得關注。2024年大選時，共和黨在30歲以下選民中的支持度幾乎與民主黨持平，但最新民調顯示，民主黨目前已在這個族群領先逾33個百分點。
其中，2024年共和黨原本在30歲以下男性選民中領先24個百分點，如今卻已反轉為民主黨領先9個百分點。
德州西語裔選民的政治傾向也出現明顯變化。2024年共和黨在該州西語裔選民中小幅領先，但最新民調顯示，民主黨參議員候選人James Talarico已取得32個百分點的領先優勢，較2024年出現33個百分點的支持度逆轉。
若民主黨最終拿下德州參議院席位，將是該黨30多年來首度在該州取得全州性選舉勝利。

參議院仍有攻防空間 共和黨寄望少數候選人突圍

儘管共和黨整體選情承壓，部分候選人仍展現出與共和黨整體趨勢不同的競爭力。
緬因州共和黨籍聯邦參議員柯林斯（Susan Collins）就是其中之一。她長期以溫和派共和黨人形象爭取選民支持，過去也能吸引獨立選民及部分民主黨選民。
民調顯示，柯林斯在45歲以上女性選民中的表現明顯優於共和黨整體候選人。這個族群在2024年總統大選時曾以兩位數差距支持民主黨，但目前柯林斯仍在該群體中占有優勢。緬因州也是今年主要參議院競爭州中，唯一一個川普在2024年未能勝出的州。
愛荷華州方面，共和黨眾議員Ashley Hinson正角逐一個懸缺的參議院席位，選情相當接近。她在競選期間已公開與川普部分政策主張保持距離。
當被ABC新聞問及是否認同川普形容美國目前擁有「A++++++級經濟」時，Hinson直言：「現在感覺可不像。」
阿拉斯加州則出現另一項選戰插曲。民主黨候選人Mary Peltola的競選團隊本週曾設法引入一名可能影響選情的第三方候選人，川普政府及該州共和黨籍州長隨即展開調查。共和黨將此事視為扭轉選情的難得機會。

共和黨候選人與川普保持距離 黨內選戰策略出現分歧

選情壓力升高，也讓共和黨內部逐漸出現不同競選策略。在部分競爭激烈的選區，候選人開始降低與川普的連結，試圖爭取中間選民。
媒體報導指出，在亞利桑那州一個涵蓋鳳凰城及斯科茨代爾部分地區的高度競爭眾議院選區，共和黨候選人Jay Feely已悄悄調整競選宣傳方式，原本印有「川普背書」字樣的競選看板，已改為「警察背書」。
不過，眾議院共和黨領袖史卡利斯（Steve Scalise）呼籲黨內候選人不要陷入對選情的焦慮，而應積極協助競爭激烈選區的共和黨同僚。
他表示：「很多人感到焦慮，是因為他們看電視，看到各種末日預言。我認為，其中一些內容是為了打擊共和黨的投票率。」
川普本人則持續密集舉行競選造勢活動，甚至多次前往原本被認為共和黨勝算穩固的地區。他將此次期中選舉形容為一場必須逆勢突圍的戰役，並聲稱自己將打破執政黨通常在期中選舉失利的歷史規律。
白宮則發表聲明，稱川普是共和黨「無可爭議的領袖、最佳的溝通者，也是無可比擬的激勵者」，並強調他正致力於維持共和黨在國會的多數地位。
不過，媒體引述知情人士報導，川普近日情緒較為低落，在連續兩週密集巡迴造勢後，聲音也已明顯沙啞。
當被問及如果民主黨掌控國會該如何因應時，川普則回應：「我們會想辦法，我擁有強大的否決權。」

items.title: AI退燒最危險的不是科技股 德銀警告美元恐掀拋售潮
items.title_en: The Biggest Risk of AI Cooling Isn’t Tech Stocks, Deutsche Bank Warns of a Dollar Sell‑off
paras: AI交易最危險的地方，或許不在科技股，而是在美元。德意志銀行警告，AI熱潮若退燒，恐引發美股與美元齊跌，迫使外國投資人增加匯率避險，進一步加重美元賣壓。海外資金持有逾20兆美元美股，下一輪AI拋售恐從科技股延燒至匯市。
根據德意志銀行估算，外國投資人持有的美國股票資產中，約90%的價值來自累積的價格上漲，而非實際淨買入。
這意味著，龐大的持股部位高度仰賴美股估值支撐，一旦股價大幅回落，資產價值也將隨之縮水。
更關鍵的是，流入美國股市的外國資金，目前已承擔美國經常帳赤字的全部融資需求，使美元與股票市場週期緊密相連。股市若出現大幅修正，支撐美元的資金來源也將直接承壓，讓原本集中在科技股的風險擴散至匯市。
美股跌 美元未必能護身
過去十年，美股下跌時，美元走強往往能替外國投資人抵銷部分損失。但這項保護機制有一個前提，就是衝擊來自美國以外。若風險源頭在美國本身，股票與美元可能同步走低，美元便未必能繼續充當損失的緩衝。
StoneX數據顯示，AI情緒與美元的5日滾動相關係數高達正0.97，20日相關係數則僅為正0.31，反映兩者短期走勢高度同步。
當AI信心動搖，美元也可能跟著承壓，而非像過去部分股市下跌期間一樣，提供避險保護。
因此，這次AI交易的風險不只在於科技股能否守住估值，也在於美元的傳統避險作用是否仍然有效。
不賣股票 也可能加重美元賣壓
對未進行匯率避險的外國投資人而言，美股與美元齊跌，意味著股票虧損之外，還得承受匯損。這種雙重打擊，可能促使投資人重新檢視美股部位的匯率風險。
即使他們沒有賣出股票，只是提高匯率避險比重，相關操作本身也會形成額外的美元賣壓，進一步壓低匯價。
德意志銀行警告，AI拋售潮可能在美股、匯率避險與美元之間形成危險循環。股匯同步下跌促使投資人增加避險，避險操作又加重美元跌勢，使市場承受的壓力超出單純股價回檔。
實質利率是關鍵判斷指標
要判斷這波波動只是部位調整，還是市場正重新評估AI繁榮週期，德意志銀行認為，美國實質利率是關鍵訊號。
該行指出，AI資本支出預期迅速膨脹，是推動美股與實質利率同步走高的重要因素之一。如果科技股、美元與美國實質利率一起下跌，便可能代表投資人開始將更疲弱的AI投資週期反映在價格中。
屆時，市場面對的將不只是科技股技術性修正，而是更廣泛的總體經濟重新定價。相反地，若實質利率維持高檔，股市調整就更可能仍屬部位層面的波動。
AI退燒 美元恐成另一個戰場
面對AI行情可能回檔，最直接的交易是放空科技股。但德意志銀行指出，較不顯眼、卻可能更具影響力的交易，是放空美元。
一旦以美國為中心的股市衝擊成真，外國投資人便可能被迫重新審視逾20兆美元股票資產的匯率避險策略，讓AI交易的影響從股市延伸至美元。
因此，納斯達克指數、美元指數(DXY) 與美國實質利率，將是觀察風險的三項重點。若三者同步走低，市場反映的疑慮可能遠超過一般部位出清，下一輪AI拋售也可能演變成美元拋售潮。
paras_en: The riskiest aspect of AI trading may not be tech stocks but the U.S. dollar. Deutsche Bank warns that if the AI hype cools, both U.S. equities and the dollar could fall together, forcing foreign investors to increase currency hedging and adding further selling pressure on the dollar. Overseas funds hold over $20 trillion of U.S. equities, and the next wave of AI sell‑offs could spread from tech stocks to the foreign‑exchange market.
Deutsche Bank estimates that about 90% of the value of foreign investors’ U.S. stock holdings comes from accumulated price gains rather than actual net purchases.
This means the massive stock positions are heavily dependent on equity valuations; a sharp drop in prices would shrink the asset value accordingly.

More critically, foreign capital flowing into U.S. equities now finances the entire U.S. current‑account deficit, tightly linking the dollar and the equity market cycle. A large equity correction would directly strain the dollar’s funding source, spreading risk from tech stocks to the FX market.
U.S. stocks fall, the dollar may not protect

In the past decade, a stronger dollar often offset part of foreign investors’ losses when U.S. stocks fell. That protection assumes the shock originates outside the United States. If the risk source is domestic, stocks and the dollar can decline together, and the dollar may no longer cushion losses.
StoneX data show the 5‑day rolling correlation between AI sentiment and the dollar is as high as +0.97, while the 20‑day correlation is only +0.31, indicating a tight short‑term sync.
When AI confidence wavers, the dollar can come under pressure too, rather than acting as a safe‑haven as it sometimes did during past equity downturns.
Thus, the risk of this AI trade lies not only in whether tech stocks can hold their valuations but also in whether the dollar’s traditional hedge function remains effective.
Not selling stocks can still add to dollar‑selling pressure

For foreign investors who have not hedged currency risk, a simultaneous drop in U.S. stocks and the dollar means they face both equity losses and foreign‑exchange losses. This double hit may prompt a reassessment of the FX risk in their U.S. equity holdings.
Even if they do not sell stocks but simply increase their hedging ratios, the hedging activity itself creates extra dollar‑selling pressure, pushing the exchange rate lower.

Deutsche Bank warns that an AI sell‑off could create a dangerous loop among equities, currency hedging and the dollar. A synchronized equity‑FX decline forces investors to hedge more, and the hedging adds to the dollar’s decline, making market stress exceed a simple equity pull‑back.
Real‑rate is the key gauge
To judge whether this volatility is merely a position adjustment or a market re‑evaluation of the AI boom cycle, Deutsche Bank says the U.S. real interest rate is the crucial signal.

The bank notes that rapidly expanding AI capital expenditures are a major driver of both equity gains and rising real rates. If tech stocks, the dollar and U.S. real rates fall together, it could signal investors are beginning to price in a weaker AI investment cycle.

In that case, the market would face not just a technical correction in tech stocks but a broader macro‑economic repricing. Conversely, if real rates stay high, the equity correction is more likely to be a position‑level swing.
AI cooling could make the dollar another battlefield
When the AI rally potentially retraces, the most direct trade is shorting tech stocks. However, Deutsche Bank points out that a less obvious but possibly more impactful trade is shorting the dollar.

If a U.S.-centric equity shock materialises, foreign investors may be forced to revisit hedging strategies for over $20 trillion of stock assets, extending AI‑related market impact from equities to the dollar.

Therefore, the Nasdaq index, the dollar index (DXY) and U.S. real rates will be the three key gauges of risk. If all three move lower together, market concerns could far exceed a routine position unwind, and the next AI sell‑off could turn into a dollar sell‑off.

items.title: AI晶片需求推升韓元！第三季狂升13%創近28年新高、南韓央行示警
items.title_en: AI Chip Demand Boosts Won! 13% Surge in Q3 Sets Near-28-Year High, BOK Issues Warning
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續升溫，帶動南韓半導體出口及外資資金流入，韓元今年第三季兌美元大幅升值約13%，創下1998年第四季以來最大單季漲幅。不過，南韓央行貨幣政策委員會成員Hwang Kunil警告，近期韓元升值速度超出預期，必須密切關注匯率波動，強勢韓元也可能對出口及中小企業造成壓力。
根據《路透》報導，Hwang指出，評估匯率時，應關注波動程度及變動速度，而非僅看匯率絕對水準。他認為，近期韓元升值步伐有些超出預期，央行正密切監測相關變化。
他也提醒，隨著龐大的經常帳順差及外資資產配置調整效應逐漸消退，韓元仍可能面臨貶值壓力。
此次示警正值南韓央行面臨貨幣政策兩難之際。央行本月在連續兩次升息後暫停升息，維持基準利率在3%，但仍保留進一步緊縮的可能性。
韓元升值雖有助降低進口成本、抑制通膨，卻也可能削弱出口競爭力，加上國內消費復甦緩慢及中小企業經營壓力升高，使政策決策更加複雜。

AI晶片需求帶動美元流入 韓元單季升幅創近28年新高

韓元第三季兌美元升值約13%，為1998年第四季以來最大單季漲幅。Hwang將這波升值主要歸因於全球AI基礎建設投資熱潮，帶動南韓半導體出口及美元資金流入。
隨著AI算力需求快速增加，市場對SK海力士(000660KS) 及三星電子(005930KS) 生產的專用記憶體晶片需求大增，推升南韓出口收入，也為韓元帶來支撐。
Hwang預估，南韓今年經常帳順差可能從央行8月預測的4,500億美元，增加至接近5,000億美元。
不過，他也指出，若全球AI支出放緩，經常帳順差可能減少約500億美元，將對以出口為導向的南韓經濟成長造成衝擊。
儘管如此，他認為，當前AI產業景氣繁榮可能持續更長時間。

強勢韓元衝擊出口 中小企業未能共享AI紅利

韓元升值並非所有產業都能受惠。雖然南韓大型半導體企業受益於AI晶片需求，但匯率走強也會提高南韓出口商品的外幣價格，削弱海外市場競爭力，對出口導向型企業形成壓力。
Hwang指出，出口在南韓經濟中的重要性雖已不如過去，但仍是經濟結構的重要支柱。目前出口表現強勁，卻未能帶動各產業及不同群體同步受惠，民間消費復甦依然緩慢。
他表示，經濟成長帶來的正面效益集中在特定群體，但高利率與高物價卻影響所有人，最終經濟表現將取決於兩股力量何者較強。
中小企業的經營狀況尤其令人憂慮。Hwang指出，南韓中小企業違約率持續上升，國內需求疲弱，企業經營壓力加重。
更值得注意的是，部分企業借款並非用於擴大資本投資，而是拿來支付薪資、原材料等日常營運成本，反映企業資金周轉及財務狀況面臨挑戰。
在此情況下，大型出口企業能夠受惠於AI晶片需求，中小企業卻未必能分享出口成長紅利，還得面對高利率及營運資金壓力，形成不同規模企業之間的景氣落差。

韓元升值有助壓通膨 南韓央行陷政策兩難

通膨走勢也是南韓央行關注的重點。Hwang預估，南韓整體消費者物價通膨率將於2027年上半年末開始接近央行2%的目標，並在2027年底或2028年初完全穩定於目標水準。
韓元升值有助降低進口商品價格，進而緩和通膨壓力，但也可能進一步壓縮出口企業的獲利空間。另一方面，能源價格風險及經濟韌性，仍是央行考慮進一步緊縮貨幣政策的因素。
Hwang被市場視為南韓央行貨幣政策委員會中最鴿派的成員之一，今年8月升息時曾投下反對票。此次公開提醒韓元升值過快，也凸顯南韓央行在穩定物價、維持出口競爭力及支撐國內經濟之間，面臨的政策取捨。
paras_en: Global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure continues to heat up, driving South Korea's semiconductor exports and foreign capital inflows, with the won appreciating about 13% against the dollar in the third quarter, the largest quarterly gain since Q4 1998. However, BOK Monetary Policy Committee member Hwang Kunil warned that the recent pace of won appreciation exceeds expectations and must be closely monitored, as a strong won could also pressure exports and small‑and‑medium enterprises.

According to Reuters, Hwang said that when assessing exchange rates, one should focus on volatility and the speed of change rather than just the absolute level. He believes the recent appreciation of the won has been somewhat beyond expectations, and the central bank is closely monitoring the developments.
He also cautioned that as the massive current‑account surplus and the effects of foreign‑asset allocation adjustments wane, the won could still face depreciation pressure.

This warning comes as the BOK faces a policy dilemma. After two consecutive rate hikes this month, the bank paused further hikes, keeping the policy rate at 3% while still leaving open the possibility of additional tightening.

While a stronger won helps lower import costs and curb inflation, it may also weaken export competitiveness, and combined with sluggish domestic consumption recovery and rising pressures on SMEs, policy decisions become more complex.

AI chip demand drives dollar inflows, won's quarterly rise hits near‑28‑year high. The won appreciated about 13% against the dollar in Q3, the biggest quarterly gain since Q4 1998. Hwang attributes this surge mainly to the global AI infrastructure investment boom, which has boosted South Korean semiconductor exports and dollar inflows.

As AI computing power demand surges, the market’s need for specialized memory chips produced by SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) has risen sharply, lifting South Korean export revenues and supporting the won.
Hwang estimates South Korea's current‑account surplus this year could rise from the BOK’s August forecast of $450 billion to nearly $500 billion.
However, he notes that if global AI spending slows, the current‑account surplus could shrink by about $50 billion, hitting the export‑driven Korean economy.
Nonetheless, he believes the current AI industry boom could last longer than expected.

Strong won hits exports; SMEs miss out on AI gains. The won’s appreciation does not benefit all sectors. While large Korean semiconductor firms profit from AI chip demand, a stronger currency raises the foreign‑currency price of Korean export goods, weakening overseas competitiveness and pressuring export‑oriented firms.

Hwang points out that although exports are less central to the Korean economy than before, they remain a key pillar. Export performance is strong but has not translated into benefits across all industries and groups, and consumer recovery remains slow.

He says the positive effects of economic growth are concentrated in specific groups, while high interest rates and prices affect everyone, and ultimately economic performance will depend on which force proves stronger.
The situation of SMEs is especially concerning. Hwang notes that default rates among Korean SMEs are rising, domestic demand is weak, and business pressures are intensifying.
Moreover, some firms borrow not to expand capital investment but to cover payroll, raw materials and other operating costs, reflecting challenges in cash flow and financial health.

In this context, large exporters can benefit from AI chip demand, but SMEs may not share in export growth gains and must still face high rates and working‑capital pressures, creating a disparity in fortunes between firms of different sizes.

Won appreciation helps tame inflation, putting the BOK in a policy bind. Inflation trends are also a key focus for the BOK. Hwang projects that South Korea’s overall consumer price inflation will approach the bank’s 2% target by the end of the first half of 2027 and fully stabilize at the target by the end of 2027 or early 2028.

A stronger won lowers import prices, easing inflation pressure, but may further squeeze profit margins for exporters. Meanwhile, energy price risks and economic resilience remain factors the bank considers when contemplating further monetary tightening.

Hwang is seen as one of the most dovish members of the BOK’s Monetary Policy Committee and cast a dissenting vote during the August rate hike. His public warning about the won’s rapid appreciation highlights the BOK’s trade‑off between stabilising prices, maintaining export competitiveness and supporting the domestic economy.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元10月上漲 升息預期居高不下
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises in October as Rate‑Hike Expectations Remain High
paras: 美元周五(30日)小幅下跌，投資人因華爾街股市遭遇沉重賣壓而撤出風險資產，轉向美國公債及日元等避險資產。日本銀行(BoJ)決議維持利率不變，但聲明透露一定程度的鷹派立場，也為日元帶來支撐。另一方面，數據顯示歐元區經濟成長放緩，歐元小幅走低。
本週美元、日元與歐元特別受到市場關注，因為聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行（ECB）也都維持利率不變。然而，分析師認為，這並非貨幣政策轉向寬鬆，而是處於一種不安的觀望狀態，尤其在地緣政治動盪推升油價居高不下的情況下。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報101.88。
麥格理全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，AI將成為決定聯準會、歐洲央行或日本銀行哪一家央行會在12月升息的重要因素。
Wizman表示，「從美國、歐元區與日本三大已開發經濟體的經濟成長規模及組成來看，很明顯，2026年AI為美國帶來的助益最大。AI對2026年經濟成長的貢獻，以及2027年至2030年生產力提升的前景，正是華許(Kevin Warsh)希望採取『鴿派』立場、並希望AI持續快速發展的原因。儘管聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）內部存在不同意見，他目前仍不願承諾再次升息。」
他指出，「對歐洲央行而言，AI同樣重要，央行聲明也承認了這點。但歐元區第四季的經濟成長不像美國那樣依賴AI基礎設施建設，因此歐洲維持AI帶動經濟成長的意願不如美國強烈。這也是為什麼歐洲央行仍將能源成本視為貨幣政策的關鍵因素。這也意味著，除非法國出現問題，否則歐洲央行12月升息的可能性高於聯準會。」
他表示，「對日本而言，美國的AI熱潮帶來的經濟成長助益，大於對歐洲的影響。這也是日本儘管遭遇油價大幅衝擊，2026年經濟仍能維持成長的原因。在政府支出發揮作用或油價下跌之前，日本經濟成長的主要動力仍來自科技硬體的外部需求，而非國內需求。如果美國AI類股表現轉弱，聯準會可能暫緩升息，但只要AI帶動的投資維持強勁，日銀就會升息。」
他進一步表示，「事實上，我們認為，日銀12月升息的可能性高於歐洲央行，而歐洲央行升息的可能性又高於聯準會。」
美元指數10月上漲約0.4%，本月聯準會的利率預期成為市場關注焦點。美國消費者物價與生產者物價數據均高於預期，加上聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數持續居高不下，使交易員在10月利率決策公布前保持警戒。
不過，FOMC本週決定維持利率不變，華許表示，在12月利率決策出爐前，仍有大量經濟數據有待公布。FOMC已於9月升息，這是三年多來首次升息，而市場目前預期12月還會再次升息。
本月美國經濟穩健成長，以及地緣政治風險溢價居高不下，也為美元帶來支撐。
歐元因GDP數據走低 日元在日銀偏鷹維持利率後趨穩
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1164美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區第三季GDP成長0.4%，低於第二季的0.6%。
受到法國主權債券利差擴大，以及能源進口支出居高不下、拖累歐元區貿易條件影響，歐元10月下跌約0.7%。
歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)證實，決策官員本週曾積極討論是否有升息必要，最後才決定維持基準存款利率在2.50%不變。這番談話使投資人對歐元的信心趨於穩定。
拉加德意外宣布將於明年2月卸任歐洲央行總裁，比原定任期提前八個月。她指出，全球債券殖利率上升正在收緊金融環境，但目前尚不需要央行立即採取干預措施。
日元兌美元小幅走強，至157.62日元。日元稍早一度貶至157.81，整體而言，10月兌美元仍小幅下跌0.1%。
日本銀行以8比1票數決議將政策利率維持在1.25%，但更新後的經濟預測顯示通膨持續存在，強化市場對進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期。政策委員Hajime Takata投下反對票，主張立即升息25個基點，將利率提高至1.50%。
這項鷹派異議進一步強化市場押注，認為總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)最快可能在12月再次升息。

paras_en: Dollar slipped slightly Friday (30th) as investors withdrew from risk assets due to heavy sell‑off in Wall Street equities, moving into safe‑haven US Treasuries and yen. BoJ voted to keep rates unchanged but its statement hinted a degree of hawkishness, giving yen some support. Meanwhile data showed euro‑area growth slowing, euro slipped modestly.

This week the dollar, yen and euro were under particular market focus because the Fed and ECB also kept rates unchanged. Analysts say this is not a shift to easing but an uneasy wait‑and‑see stance, especially as geopolitical turmoil keeps oil prices high.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies fell 0.2% to 101.88.
Macquarie Global FX and Rates strategist Thierry Wizman said AI will be a decisive factor in which central bank – the Fed, ECB or BoJ – will raise rates in December.

Wizman said, “Looking at the scale and composition of economic growth in the three major developed economies – the US, the euro‑area and Japan – it is clear that AI will bring the greatest benefit to the United States in 2026. The contribution of AI to 2026 growth and the prospect of productivity gains from 2027‑2030 are why Kevin Warsh wants to adopt a dovish stance and hopes AI continues to develop rapidly. Although there are dissenting views within the FOMC, he is still unwilling to commit to another hike.”

He added, “For the ECB, AI is also important and the central‑bank statement acknowledges this. But the euro‑area’s Q4 growth does not rely on AI infrastructure construction as much as the US, so Europe’s willingness to let AI drive growth is weaker. That is why the ECB still treats energy costs as a key policy factor. It also means that, unless France runs into trouble, the ECB’s chance of a December hike is higher than the Fed’s.”

He said, “For Japan, the US AI boom’s growth boost is larger than its impact on Europe. That is why Japan can still grow in 2026 despite a sharp oil‑price shock. Until fiscal stimulus takes effect or oil prices fall, Japan’s growth will mainly come from external demand for tech hardware, not domestic demand. If US AI‑related stocks weaken, the Fed may pause hikes, but as long as AI‑driven investment stays strong, the BoJ will raise rates.”
He further noted, “In fact, we think the BoJ’s probability of a December hike is higher than the ECB’s, and the ECB’s probability is higher than the Fed’s.”

The dollar index rose about 0.4% in October, with the market’s focus on the Fed’s rate expectations this month. US CPI and PPI both came in above forecasts, and the Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – remains elevated, keeping traders cautious ahead of the October rate decision.

However, the FOMC this week kept rates unchanged. Warsh said that a lot of economic data remain to be released before the December decision. The FOMC raised rates in September, the first hike in more than three years, and markets currently expect another hike in December.
Robust US economic growth this month and a high geopolitical risk premium also support the dollar.
Euro falls on weak GDP data; yen steadies after BoJ’s slightly hawkish rate hold.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1164. Earlier data showed euro‑area Q3 GDP growth of 0.4%, down from 0.6% in Q2.
Driven by widening French sovereign spreads and persistently high energy import costs hurting euro‑area terms of trade, the euro dropped about 0.7% in October.

ECB President Christine Lagarde confirmed that policymakers this week actively debated whether a hike was needed before finally deciding to keep the deposit rate at 2.50% unchanged. The discussion steadied investor confidence in the euro.

Lagarde unexpectedly announced she will step down as ECB president in February 2025, eight months earlier than planned. She said rising global bond yields are tightening financial conditions, but immediate central‑bank intervention is not yet required.
The yen edged stronger against the dollar to 157.62 per dollar. It had briefly slipped to 157.81 earlier; overall in October the yen was down about 0.1% versus the dollar.

The BoJ voted 8‑1 to keep its policy rate at 1.25%, but its updated economic outlook showed inflation persisting, reinforcing market expectations of further tightening. Policy‑maker Hajime Takata cast the dissenting vote, urging an immediate 25‑basis‑point hike to 1.50%.
This hawkish dissent further bolstered bets that Governor Kazuo Ueda could raise rates again as early as December.
Derivatives markets currently price roughly an 80% chance of a rate hike before year‑end.

items.title: 法國政經動盪拖累歐元！兌英鎊恐寫逾四年最慘單月表現
items.title_en: France's Political and Economic Turmoil Drags the Euro; Against the Pound May Record Its Worst Monthly Performance in Over Four Years
paras: 法國政治與財政風險升高，拖累歐元兌英鎊走弱，10月跌幅已超過2%，恐創2022年7月以來最差單月表現。相較之下，英國經濟數據優於預期，加上本周預算案未掀起太大波瀾，凸顯相對穩定的局勢，支撐英鎊表現。
歐元兌英鎊周五(30日)跌至2025年4月以來最低。英鎊本月兌歐元的升幅，則居十大工業國(G10)貨幣之冠，反映投資人對英法兩國前景的評價差距擴大。
法國遲遲難以控制預算赤字，引發債市劇烈波動，推升政府借款成本至25年高點，也壓抑歐元走勢。隨著明年全國性選舉逼近，教育制度與生活成本問題引發的抗議，更增添政治不確定性。
富國銀行(WFC-US)策略師Marcus Jennings表示，法國身為歐元區第二大經濟體，政治與財政風險升高，加上英國經濟相對有韌性，可能使歐元兌英鎊跌勢延續。他預估，年底前匯價將降至接近0.83英鎊。
Jennings指出，歐元區成長動能出現減弱跡象，英國數據卻持續優於預期。國際貨幣基金(IMF)本月稍早也上調英國經濟成長預測，進一步支撐英鎊。
不過，英國自身仍面臨財政難題。許多投資人質疑政府能否落實控制支出的承諾，相關疑慮已拖累英鎊兌美元表現，而財政限制也可能壓抑未來幾年的經濟成長。
選擇權市場目前同樣顯示，歐元兌英鎊情緒轉弱，逆轉周四觸及四周高點的樂觀程度。歐洲央行當天淡化了市場對其可能介入、平息法債賣壓的預期。
荷蘭合作銀行G10外匯策略主管Jane Foley表示，法國困境讓英鎊顯得相對有吸引力，預期政治風險將持續壓抑歐元至明年。
paras_en: France's political and fiscal risks are rising, weighing down the euro against the pound, which has fallen more than 2% in October and could mark the worst monthly performance since July 2022. In contrast, UK economic data have been better than expected and this week's budget did not cause major turbulence, highlighting a relatively stable situation that supports the pound.

The euro fell to its lowest level against the pound since April 2025 on Friday (the 30th). The pound's gain against the euro this month tops the G10 industrial nation currencies, reflecting a widening investor rating gap between the UK and France.

France's difficulty in controlling its budget deficit has sparked severe bond market volatility, pushing government borrowing costs to a 25‑year high and suppressing the euro's trajectory. With a national election looming next year, protests over the education system and living‑cost issues add further political uncertainty.

Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) strategist Marcus Jennings said that France, as the euro‑area’s second‑largest economy, faces heightened political and fiscal risks, while the UK economy remains relatively resilient, which could keep the euro‑pound decline going. He forecasts the exchange rate could fall to around £0.83 by year‑end.

Jennings noted that growth momentum in the euro area is showing signs of weakening, whereas UK data continue to beat expectations. The International Monetary Fund also raised its UK growth forecast earlier this month, further bolstering the pound.

However, the UK still faces its own fiscal challenges. Many investors doubt the government’s ability to stick to its spending‑control promises, a concern that has already weighed on the pound‑dollar pair, and fiscal constraints could curb economic growth in the coming years.

The options market also now shows weakening sentiment for the euro‑pound pair, reversing the optimism that had pushed it to a four‑week high on Thursday. The European Central Bank on that day downplayed expectations that it might intervene to calm French bond‑selling pressure.

Jane Foley, head of G10 FX strategy at Dutch cooperative bank ABN Amro, said France’s troubles make the pound look relatively attractive and she expects political risk to keep the euro under pressure into next year.

paras_en: China's three main A‑share indices all closed lower on Friday (Oct 30). The Shanghai Composite (SSEC) posted a second straight daily loss, slipping below the 3,600‑point threshold, down 2.48% for the week and marking a sixth consecutive weekly decline; the monthly chart is down more than 6%. Both the ChiNext Index and the STAR‑50 index are down over 23% on the month. The Shenzhen Component (SZI) also logged its sixth weekly loss, falling 7.2% for the week and ending the month down 15.94%.

The Shanghai index fell 1.44% on Friday to 3,599.02 points, while the Shenzhen index dropped 2.73% to 10,833.78 points. The ChiNext index closed down 4.13% at 2,413.63 points and the STAR‑50 index plunged 5.48%. Total market turnover reached 1.6744 trillion yuan, an increase of 117.9 billion yuan from the previous day.

On the market front, the optical‑communication sector led the declines, with companies such as Coretronic, Canqian Technology, Huichang Technology, Dekoli and Quectel hitting limit‑down or falling more than 10%. Tai­chen Guang, Xin‑Yisheng and Shenghong Technology each fell over 13%. Film‑theatre stocks also suffered heavy losses, with Wenti Holding, Hengdian Film, Ciwen Media, Aofei Entertainment and Jicheng Shares touching limit‑down. Software, semiconductor and defense‑industry groups were among the worst‑performing, with more than 20 stocks—including Tongda Sea, Compass, Daotong Technology, Fortune Trend, BGI Genomics and 3D World—either limit‑down or down over 10%.

Among the gainers, the liquor sector surged throughout the session, with Black Sesame, Luzhou Laojiao, New Dairy, Huangtai Liquor, Gujing Gong Jiu, Yingjia Gong Jiu, Qingdao Food and Haoxiangni all hitting limit‑up. Port and shipping stocks also saw a wave of limit‑ups, led by Jinjiang Shipping and COSCO Shipping. The banking sector continued its rally, with Xi’an Bank soaring 8.64%, Qingnan Bank jumping 5.57%, and Suzhou Bank, Changsha Bank and others gaining more than 2%.

According to Wind data, a total of 893 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchanges, while 4,598 fell and 82 were unchanged. Data from Dazhihui VIP shows that across the three markets, 61 stocks gained more than 9% and 266 stocks lost more than 9%.

Donghai Securities noted that the Shanghai index reclaimed its 5‑day moving average only to lose it again, with volume easing and large‑order capital flowing out rather than in—net outflows exceeded 25.6 billion yuan. The daily KDJ has not yet formed a death cross and the daily MACD has not produced a golden cross, leaving the daily indicators contradictory. The index is again approaching support at the 555‑day moving average and is close to the 120‑week average of 3,618 points. Technical conditions on the daily chart are not yet clearly improving; minute‑level indicators are weakening again. The index faces pressure from the 5‑week and 10‑week averages above and support from the 120‑week average below, suggesting a possible short‑term range‑bound pattern.

Zhongyuan Securities believes the current average price‑to‑earnings ratios for the Shanghai Composite and the ChiNext are 16.14 × and 37.37 × respectively, both above the three‑year median, making them suitable for medium‑ to long‑term positioning. National Bureau of Statistics data shows GDP grew 4.6% year‑on‑year in the first three quarters, with high‑tech manufacturing’s share of industrial added value above scale rising 1.6 percentage points. New‑energy drivers contribute over 40% to growth. The Shanghai index is likely to continue oscillating, with structural rebalancing as a core feature. Investors should monitor macro data, overseas liquidity and policy trends, and in the short term focus on aerospace equipment, defense electronics, wind‑power equipment and banks for investment opportunities.

Wanlian Securities also said that economic data indicate a stable national economy and that macro‑policy remains moderately accommodative. In the capital market, October’s A‑share liquidity indicators were mixed, and investor sentiment and risk appetite were affected by multiple factors, so market improvement still needs more support. As regulators deepen comprehensive reforms of capital market financing, expanding patient, long‑term and strategic capital supply, market resilience is expected to strengthen and liquidity conditions improve. With multiple bullish policies, confidence should recover. From a performance perspective, third‑quarter earnings are nearing completion, revealing structural highlights: on one hand, new‑quality productivity sectors are maintaining high growth driven by technological innovation and supply‑chain coordination; on the other, overseas‑focused leading firms with technology, cost and supply‑chain advantages are showing strong earnings resilience.

items.title: 強通膨+鷹派央行+AI資金撐腰！美元將創近一年半最佳月度表現　分析師：美大選難改強勢邏輯
items.title_en: Strong Inflation, Hawkish Central Banks, and AI Funding Back the Dollar—Projected Best Monthly Performance in a Year and a Half, Analysts Say U.S. Election Won’t Reverse the Trend
paras: 美元正走出一輪強勢行情，美元指數10月攀升至2025年5月以來高位，今年來累計上漲約3.45%，主要因為強於預期的通膨、Fed可能重啟升息的預期，以及AI投資帶來的資本流入，華爾街多家機構已陸續撤回看空判斷，CFTC數據也顯示資管機構與非商業交易者押注美元升值的部位規模近400億美元，自3月中以來始終維持多頭立場。
利率預期是核心支柱。Fed週三(28日)維持利率不變，但主席華許釋放明確鷹派訊號，並稱官員已做好「採取行動的準備」。 Fed上月做出三年來首次升息決定，帶動美元創3月以來最佳單月表現，市場定價繼續為匯價托底。
宏利投資投資組合經理Nathan Thooft指出，不應過度放大美國期中選舉對美元長期走勢的影響。 「外匯市場更多由相對經濟成長、通膨、利率和資本流動所驅動。」
他並認為，若選舉形成分裂政府，政策不確定性反而可能下降，為美元提供穩定性。
AI資金是另一個關鍵支撐。美銀策略師Alex Cohen表示，即便民主黨在11月3日選舉中拿下國會至少一院，川普仍可用否決權擋住AI監管立法，意味著推動美元走強的「AI交易」未必熄火。
Cohen也明確指出，若選舉後美元因AI敘事降溫而遭拋售，將反向加碼。
根據花旗策略師Daniel Tobon統計，歷屆美國期中大選過後，美元往往偏弱，但本輪即使回落，持續時間可能很短，因通膨韌性與Fed緊縮會抵消政治擾動。
摩根士丹利也已推翻「2026年美元持續走弱」的預測，該行G10外匯主管Steven Englander強調，只要市場相信Fed繼續壓低通膨、維持較高實際利率，美元就有上行空間。
不過，下檔風險正在累積。Man Group首席市場策略師Kristina Hooper提醒，AI資本開支若明顯放緩，將削弱美國成長預期與國際資金流入動力。
地緣局勢同樣攸關美元走勢，美伊戰爭擾動能源供應，油價今年來上漲約80%，利多美元、壓制歐元與日元，加上法國財政惡化也加重歐元貶值壓力。
加拿大帝國商業銀行(CIBC)資本市場策略師Noah Buffam則指出，最該盯的變數是川普選後如何處理伊朗，若克制用兵，美元可能與油價一同回落。
綜合來看，美國11月3日選舉結果未必直接決定美元方向。短期由通膨與Fed鷹派定調，中期看AI投資能否延續，長期則繫於中東局勢，強美元邏輯，暫時未到反轉時。
paras_en: The dollar is emerging from a strong rally, with the U.S. Dollar Index climbing to its highest level since May 2025 in October and having risen about 3.45% year‑to‑date, driven by stronger‑than‑expected inflation, expectations that the Fed may restart rate hikes, and capital inflows from AI investment. Several Wall Street firms have already withdrawn bearish views, and CFTC data shows that asset‑management firms and non‑commercial traders have bet on dollar appreciation with positions close to $40 billion, maintaining a long stance since mid‑March.

Rate expectations are the core pillar. The Fed left rates unchanged on Wednesday (28th), but Chairman Jerome Powell sent a clear hawkish signal and said officials were ready to "take action." Last month, the Fed made its first rate hike in three years, sparking the dollar’s best single‑month performance since March, and markets continue to price in support for the currency.

Macro‑investment portfolio manager Nathan Thooft of Macro Investments said the U.S. midterm election should not be overstated in its long‑term impact on the dollar. "The forex market is driven more by relative economic growth, inflation, rates, and capital flows," he said.
He also believes that if the election results in a divided government, policy uncertainty could actually decrease, providing stability for the dollar.

AI funding is another key support. Bank of America strategist Alex Cohen noted that even if the Democrats win at least one house in the November 3 election, Trump could still use his veto power to block AI regulatory legislation, meaning the "AI trading" that fuels dollar strength may not die down.
Cohen also made it clear that if the dollar is sold off due to a cooling AI narrative after the election, it will be bought back in reverse.

According to Citigroup strategist Daniel Tobon, historically the dollar tends to weaken after U.S. midterm elections, but this time even if it falls, the duration may be short because inflation resilience and Fed tightening will offset political turbulence.

Morgan Stanley has also overturned its forecast of a continued dollar weakness through 2026. G10 FX head Steven Englander emphasized that as long as markets believe the Fed will keep inflation low and maintain higher real rates, the dollar has upside potential.

However, downside risk is accumulating. Man Group chief market strategist Kristina Hooper warned that a significant slowdown in AI capital spending would weaken U.S. growth expectations and the momentum of international capital inflows.

Geopolitical developments also affect the dollar. U.S.–Iran tensions disrupt energy supplies, and oil prices have risen about 80% this year, which is a tailwind for the dollar and a headwind for the euro and yen. France’s deteriorating fiscal situation also adds pressure on the euro.

CIBC capital markets strategist Noah Buffam pointed out that the most important variable to watch is how Trump will handle Iran after the election. If he restrains military action, the dollar could fall alongside oil prices.

Overall, the November 3 election outcome may not directly determine the dollar’s direction. In the short term, inflation and a hawkish Fed set the tone; in the medium term, it depends on whether AI investment continues; in the long term, it hinges on Middle East dynamics. The logic of a strong dollar remains, and a reversal has not yet arrived.

items.title: 3000艘商船通過+15億桶石油出口！美軍荷姆茲海峽護航有成  但代價是每月狂燒30億美元
items.title_en: 3000 Ships Pass, Over 1.5 Billion Barrels of Oil Exported! US Navy’s Hormuz Escort Succeeds, but at a Cost of Up to $30 Billion a Month
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國在荷姆茲海峽的全天候護航與封鎖行動的成本日益升高，5萬美軍在中東部署，加上20艘艦艇，雙航空母艦與兩棲攻擊艦的，每月耗費資金20億到30億美元。儘管行動有效恢復了石油運輸，但這套防護體系的代價正急劇上升，艦員與裝備承受極限壓力。
美軍「喬治·華盛頓」號航艦戰機每夜升空，前往荷姆茲海峽攔截伊朗飛彈與無人機，幾乎每日進行護航行動。在F-35C與F/A-18戰機構築的防護網下，美軍中央司令部表示，過去六個月已協助超過3000艘商船通過海峽，累計出口石油達15億桶，波斯灣石油出口近期重新超過戰前水平。
美軍表示，約95%的航運交通能安全通過，但伊朗持續發動挑戰，10月成為開戰以來商船遇襲最頻繁月份，相關事件超過35起，主要依賴無人機與被稱為「會飛的校車」的大型亞音速巡弋飛彈。
美軍航艦連續數月全天候運作，幾乎沒有休整，部署天數創下現代紀錄。隨行的飛彈驅逐艦任務同樣繁重。
美國海軍作戰部長Daryl Caudle表示，海軍已在印度洋迪戈加西亞島建立維修中心，並增加艦員靠港休整機會。他強調，水兵能接受長期部署，但需要明確期限與休息。在航艦甲板下，地勤與維修人員壓力巨大，飛機故障率隨飛行次數激增。
政治層面，美伊局勢持續緊繃。白宮稱不會在期中大選前攻擊伊朗，但總統川普正考慮新一輪軍事打擊選項。部分官員擔憂，若無更多國際力量參與，當前封鎖難以長期維持。
對於前線飛行員來說，荷姆茲海峽最窄處僅約20英里，空域擁擠，反應時間往往只有數秒。儘管美軍稱保護任務成功率達100%，但伊朗有時會同時攻擊多艘船隻，超出防護範圍。美軍航艦指揮官Jeffrey L. Heames少將表示，儘管部署無明確終點，艦員士氣仍高。
分析人士認為，時間站在美國一邊。布魯金斯學會研究主任Michael O’Hanlon指出，川普應給予海上封鎖更多時間，逐步削弱伊朗，並明確表態做好無限期維持封鎖的準備。這場圍繞荷姆茲海峽的博弈，正考驗美軍的戰略定力。
paras_en: Foreign media reports say the United States’ round‑the‑clock escort and blockade operation in the Strait of Hormuz is becoming ever more expensive, with 50,000 troops deployed in the Middle East and 20 warships—including two aircraft carriers and amphibious assault ships—costing $2‑3 billion each month. Although the operation has effectively restored oil shipments, the price of the protection system is soaring, pushing crews and equipment to their limits.

U.S. carrier‑based aircraft from the USS George Washington launch nightly to intercept Iranian missiles and drones over the Strait of Hormuz, conducting escort missions almost every day. Under a protective umbrella of F‑35C and F/A‑18 fighters, U.S. Central Command says that in the past six months more than 3,000 merchant vessels have transited the strait, carrying a cumulative 1.5 billion barrels of oil, and Gulf oil exports have recently risen above pre‑war levels again.

The U.S. military says about 95 % of shipping traffic can pass safely, but Iran continues to launch challenges; October was the month with the most merchant‑ship attacks since the war began, with over 35 incidents, mainly using drones and a large subsonic cruise missile dubbed the “flying school bus.”

Carrier decks have been operating around the clock for consecutive months with virtually no downtime, setting a modern record for deployment length. The accompanying missile‑destroyer escorts are equally hard‑pressed.

U.S. Navy Chief of Naval Operations Daryl Caudle said the Navy has opened a maintenance hub on Diego Garcia in the Indian Ocean and is increasing opportunities for sailors to rest in port. He stressed that sailors can endure long deployments but need clear time limits and rest periods. On carrier decks, ground crews and maintenance staff are under huge pressure, and aircraft failure rates climb sharply with each flight sortie.

Politically, U.S.–Iran tensions remain high. The White House says it will not strike Iran before the mid‑term elections, but President Trump is reportedly weighing a new round of military options. Some officials warn that without greater international participation the current blockade cannot be sustained indefinitely.

For frontline pilots, the narrowest point of the Strait of Hormuz is only about 20 miles wide, making the airspace extremely congested with reaction times often measured in seconds. Although the U.S. claims a 100 % success rate for its protection missions, Iran sometimes attacks multiple vessels simultaneously, overwhelming the defensive envelope. Carrier commander Rear Admiral Jeffrey L. Heames said morale remains high even though there is no defined end‑point for the deployment.

Analysts say time is on America’s side. Michael O’Hanlon, director of research at the Brookings Institution, argues that Trump should give the maritime blockade more time, gradually weakening Iran while clearly stating the U.S. is prepared to maintain the blockade indefinitely. This Hormuz showdown is testing the strategic resolve of the U.S. military.
